description: AVI-SPL is a leader in the video conferencing and audio visual industry. The Company provides system integration and managed services for professional video conferencing and AV installations in the corporate, education, performance venue, and government sectors in over 20 countries.

name: Blackhawk Network
description: Blackhawk Network is a global financial technology company and a leader in prepaid gift, reward and incentive technologies and solutions. Blackhawk’s prepaid payments network connects more than 1,000 brands to over 244,000 retail distribution locations and online channels.

name: BlackLine
description: BlackLine is a leading provider of enterprise-class solutions to automate and control mission-critical financial close processes.

name: Blue Danube System
description: Blue Danube Systems is a provider of wireless antenna technology. The company’s High Definition Active Antenna System (HDAAS) is a low-cost solution that can be integrated into the current wireless infrastructure through a simple retrofit. HDAAS delivers significant increases in wireless capacity to wireless operators.

name: Broadcom
description: Broadcom, formerly Avago Technologies, is a leading designer, developer, and global supplier of a broad range of analog and digital semiconductor connectivity solutions serving the wired infrastructure, wireless communications, enterprise storage, and industrial end-markets.

name: Byju’s
description: Byju’s is a pioneer and the leading player in India’s online EdTech industry. It offers interactive learning modules for pre-K and K-12 students, and online test preparation classes for undergraduate and postgraduate exams. The company has also expanded into international markets through its unique offerings and partnerships with leading global content providers.

name: Carbon
description: Carbon3D is a 3D printing company working at the intersection of hardware, software and molecular science. Its Continuous Liquid Interface Production technology (CLIP) harnesses light and oxygen to grow commercial quality parts 25-100X faster than conventional 3D printing.

name: Caris Life Sciences
description: Caris Life Sciences is a leading provider of AI-enabled molecular diagnostics services. The company offers a suite of molecular profiling offerings assessing DNA, RNA, and proteins to reveal a molecular blueprint that helps physicians and cancer patients make more precise and personalized treatment decisions.

name: Carta
description: Carta is a leading cap table management software and equity administration platform with a mission to create “more owners” by facilitating simple and transparent equity issuance and therefore increased employee ownership. The company’s cap table and investor reporting products serve as the system of record for equity ownership across private markets, and its CartaX platform enables companies to offer their shareholders access to efficient and transparent auction-based liquidity.

name: Casago (formerly Vacasa)
description: Casago (formerly Vacasa) is the largest vacation rental platform in North America. The Company’s integrated technology and services platform provides an end-to-end management solution to vacation homeowners, including dynamic pricing, multi-channel distribution, and optimization of maintenance services.

name: Cast & Crew
description: Cast & Crew grew as a premier provider of technology-enabled payroll, production accounting and related value-added services to the entertainment industry. The Company helped content creators manage the complexities of entertainment industry payroll processing; residuals processing; tax incentives and financial services; regulatory compliance; and production accounting. It was acquired by EQT.

name: CDW
description: CDW is the leading direct marketer of multi-branded information technology products and services to business, government, education and healthcare customers. The Company markets Dell, HP, and Cisco branded products, among others, worldwide.

name: Cegid
description: Cegid is a European leader in enterprise management software and cloud services, offering a suite of SaaS solutions to its customers in France, Iberia, and globally. In addition to finance, tax, and human resources, the company also provides industry-specific cloud solutions for retailers, accountants, manufacturers, and other service-sector professionals.

name: Celonis
description: Celonis is a global leader in process mining and enterprise automation software, enabling companies to generate “x-rays” of their business processes to identify inefficiencies and enable optimization.

name: City Football Group
description: City Football Group is the world’s leading soccer platform, encompassing both marquee clubs in established markets and a global footprint across attractive long-term growth geographies.

name: Clari/Salesloft
description: Clari/Salesloft is a leading provider of an end-to-end revenue platform that combines revenue operations, sales engagement, and conversation intelligence to enable real-time forecasting, pipeline visibility, and optimized go-to-market execution.

name: Con-Pearl
description: Con-pearl is a leading manufacturer and marketer of recycled plastic products with a focus on the automotive and packaging sectors. The Company supplies lightweight, recyclable, and environmentally-friendly plastic solutions to a variety of industries with an innovative and proprietary product portfolio.

name: Convenience Bee
description: Convenience Bee is a leading homegrown tech-enabled consumer retail platform in China, operating a large network of convenience stores across the country.

name: Cornerstone
description: Cornerstone OnDemand is a global leader in cloud-based learning and human capital management software. The company solutions help organizations to realize the potential of the modern workforce. It was acquired by Clearlake Capital.

name: Credit Karma
description: Credit Karma offers its members digital tools for monitoring and improving credit health through the company’s personal financial technology platform. The company also leverages advanced data modeling to provide a full suite of personalized financial product recommendations. Credit Karma was acquired by Intuit.

name: Crystal Decisions / Business Objects
description: Crystal Decisions, formerly known as Seagate Software Information Management Group, grew as a business intelligence company known for its flagship product, Crystal Reports, one of the most widely used report creation products available at the time. Crystal Decisions was acquired by Business Objects, an enterprise software company with a similar focus on business intelligence, in 2003, and Business Objects was later acquired by SAP.

name: Ctrip
description: Ctrip, now Trip.com, is a leading multinational provider of accommodation reservations, transportation ticketing, packaged tours, and corporate travel management. It was the largest online consolidator of accommodations and transportation tickets in China in terms of transaction volume.

name: Datek Online / Ameritrade
description: Datek Online grew as an internet broker before being acquired by Ameritrade in 2002. In 2006, Ameritrade became TD Ameritrade and has since remained an online brokerage firm.

name: Dell Technologies
description: Dell Technologies is a leading provider of end-to-end IT solutions, including data center infrastructure and software, end-user computing devices, cloud solutions and security solutions. The company serves customers ranging from the world’s largest businesses to individual consumers.

name: Diamond Baseball Holdings
description: Diamond Baseball Holdings (DBH) owns and operates select Minor League Baseball Clubs affiliated with Major League Baseball. DBH seeks to support, promote and enhance its clubs through professional management, best practices, innovation and investment, with the mission to elevate fan and player experiences and enrich communities across the country.

name: Didi Chuxing
description: Didi is China’s leading one-stop mobile transportation platform. The company offers a broad range of transportation options through a smartphone application, including e-hailing of privately owned vehicles, taxis, and black cars and long-distance ride-sharing, across over 400 cities in China.

name: eConnections
description: eConnections made its mark as an Internet-based supply-chain management services company for the electronics industry.

name: Eka
description: Eka is a leading international provider of commodity trading and risk management software, covering trading and position management, physical supply chain, enterprise risk management and compliance and analytics.

name: Electronic Arts
description: Electronic Arts is a global leader in digital interactive entertainment. The company is focused on building games and experiences that grow the global online communities around its key franchises and intellectual property, while deepening engagement through innovation and interactive storytelling.

name: Endeavor Group Holdings
description: Endeavor Group Holdings is the parent company of WME Group, which comprises category leaders representing talent, intellectual property and brands. It also holds a controlling ownership stake in TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO), one of the largest publicly traded sports and entertainment companies, fueled by businesses including UFC and WWE.

name: Enterasys
description: Enterasys Networks, Inc. is an American networking company, providing networking equipment ranging from routers, switches, and IEEE 802.11 wireless access points and controllers. It was acquired by Extreme Networks.

name: Entrata
description: Entrata is a leading property management software platform that offers a suite of solutions spanning the full resident lifecycle, helping property managers and owners with marketing, leasing, resident services, and core property management.

name: Equinox Group
description: Equinox Group is a high-growth collective of the world’s most influential lifestyle brands, that are disruptive leaders in the convergence of fitness, experiences and community, including Equinox, SoulCycle, Blink Fitness, and others.

name: EverCommerce
description: EverCommerce is a leading provider of business management software, marketing and payments technology for small and medium-sized businesses in the services sector.

name: Exact
description: Exact is a market-leading provider of business application software, and serving accountants and businesses in Benelux with high value-add solutions in the cloud. The company’s integrated software suite includes accounting, tax, logistics, CRM, HR, and payroll.

name: Expedia Group
description: Expedia Group is a leading global travel e-commerce platform with an extensive portfolio of well-recognized brands, providing a wide range of travel products for leisure and business travelers.

name: Facile.it
description: Facile.it is the leading Italian tech-enabled broker that provides millions of customers access every month to a product offering across insurance and financial products through its omnichannel distribution network of stores and agents.

name: Fanatics Collectibles
description: Fanatics Collectibles is a direct-to-consumer platform and licensee of sports and entertainment trading cards and collectibles, including for some of the world’s leading sports leagues and players associations.

name: Fanatics, Inc.
description: Fanatics is a leading global digital sports and eCommerce platform, with offerings including officially licensed sports merchandise, trading cards and collectibles, and digital collectibles and NFTs.

name: FATHOM
description: FATHOM became the leading provider of integrated utility-to-utility, cloud-based data and customer service solutions for water utilities, bringing heightened efficiencies to water utilities and their customers.

name: First Advantage
description: First Advantage is a global software and data company that provides comprehensive, end-to-end identity solutions, criminal background screening, credential verifications, drug and health screening, and continuous risk monitoring. Combining AI-powered proprietary technology platforms with proprietary data, primary source data, and third-party data, First Advantage helps organizations hire with confidence and manage risk across the entire employee lifecycle.

name: Flextronics
description: Flextronics is a global electronics manufacturer that delivers technology innovation, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions to various industries and end markets. In 2015, the company rebranded from Flextronics to Flex.

name: Flix
description: Flix is an asset-light travel technology platform to enable high-quality and cost-efficient intercity bus and train travel across Europe and the U.S. by partnering with independent bus and train operators and using proprietary data analytics.

name: ForeFlight
description: ForeFlight is a leading provider of digital flight planning and navigation software. The company’s products help pilots and flight departments plan flights, increase flight safety and efficiency and are widely used across personal, corporate, air transport, and government operations.

name: G42
description: G42 is a global leader in creating visionary artificial intelligence capabilities and infrastructure in partnership with government and corporate customers around the world.

name: Gartner
description: Gartner is a global research and advisory firm that provides information, advice, and tools for senior leaders across the enterprise, including finance, human resources, information technology, customer service and support, legal and compliance, product management, and sales.

name: Genies
description: Genies is a leading Web3-enabled digital avatar ecosystem company with a vision to empower authentic digital identity in the metaverse.

name: Gerson Lehrman Group
description: Gerson Lehrman Group grew to manage the world’s leading network of experts and provide technology and services to support a marketplace for expertise, helping the world’s leading financial services firms, consultancies, corporations, and nonprofit organizations find, engage, and manage experts for information in a broad range of industries and disciplines.

name: Getir
description: Getir is a leading tech-enabled, on-demand retail logistics provider. The company is a pioneer in the “ultrafast” delivery category having revolutionized last-mile delivery with its 10-minute grocery delivery proposition in 2015. Getir delivers a selection of 1,500 everyday items to wherever its customers wish within minutes, 7 days a week, day and night.

name: Global Blue
description: Global Blue is a leading strategic technology and payments partner empowering global merchants to capture the growth of international shoppers, primarily via its Tax Free Shopping, Added-Value Payments and Complementary Retail Tech segments.

name: Global Payments
description: Global Payments is a leading payments technology company delivering innovative software and services to over four million merchant locations across 170 countries.

name: GlobalFoundries
description: GlobalFoundries is a leading global semiconductor foundry company headquartered in the United States. The company manufactures complex, feature-rich integrated circuits that enable billions of devices, powering nearly every sector of the global economy.

name: GoDaddy
description: Go Daddy is a leading provider of cloud-based software and services that enable, empower, and improve the online presence of small-and-medium-sized businesses. Go Daddy offers domain registration, web hosting, and related value-added services.

name: GoodRx
description: GoodRx is the leading, consumer-focused digital healthcare platform in the United States. Initially focused on offering consumers drug price transparency, GoodRx has expanded into new business lines in pursuit of becoming consumers’ go-to destination for their healthcare journey and increasing the value of the platform for providers.

name: Groupe Meilleurtaux
description: Groupe Meilleurtaux is a leading omnichannel insurance broker in France, Belgium and Luxembourg, offering a broad and diversified range of brokerage and distribution services for credit, insurance and savings & investment products.

name: Groupon
description: Groupon, a leading social commerce site, offers deals on local products and services in hundreds of markets around the world.

name: Grupo BC
description: Grupo BC is the leading tech-enabled processing platform and software provider for mortgage management, legal solutions and digitally-enabled services to financial institutions in Iberia and Latin America.

name: Hillstone Networks
description: Hillstone Networks is a provider of network security equipment (firewall and Unified Threat Management products) to carriers, data centers, enterprises, and SMBs in China.

name: Hyla Mobile
description: HYLA Mobile (formerly eRecyclingCorps) is one of the world’s leading providers of mobile device trade-in and reuse solutions. HYLA Mobile was acquired by Assurant.

name: i2
description: i2, acquired by IBM, grew as a leading provider of technology solutions enabling its law enforcement, military, homeland security, intelligence and other government agency customers to use advanced analysis and visualization technology to monitor, manage and solve investigations more effectively.

name: Imagine Learning
description: Imagine Learning is a leading digital education platform that develops digital curricula and tools for millions of primary and secondary school students across the United States.

name: Instinet
description: Instinet, a pioneer in electronic trading, was acquired by the Nasdaq Stock Market and is now part of Nomura Group.

name: Integrity Marketing Group
description: Integrity Marketing Group is a leading, tech-enabled distributor of health insurance, life insurance and wealth solutions focused on the Senior Market.

name: Intelsat
description: Intelsat is the world’s largest provider of fixed satellite services, delivering advanced transmission access for information and entertainment to some of the world’s leading media and network companies, multinational corporations, Internet service providers, and governmental agencies.

name: Interactive Data Corporation
description: Interactive Data Corporation became a leader in the financial information services industry by supplying pricing and reference data to the back offices of financial institutions around the world and enabling clients to complete mission critical functions such as portfolio valuation, regulatory compliance, and risk management while also serving clients’ needs in electronic trading, wealth management, real time market data, and fixed income analytics.

name: IonQ
description: IonQ is a leader in trapped ion quantum computing. The company is building hardware and software that leverage quantum physics to use information in a fundamentally different way from classical computing, allowing customers to tackle problems unsolvable by current technology, including fundamental problems relating to how to live sustainably on our planet, cure diseases, and efficiently move people and goods.

name: IPC
description: IPC is a leading provider of mission-critical communications solutions primarily to the financial services industry. The Company’s Trading Systems and Network Services solutions differentiate IPC as one of the few integrated providers of trading systems, maintenance, and communications services.

name: Island / Instinet Group
description: Instinet is an institutional, agency-model broker that executes trades for asset management firms, hedge funds, insurance companies, mutual funds, and pension funds. The company offers sales trading services and trading technologies, including algorithms, trade cost analysis, commission management, and independent research.

name: Iterable
description: Iterable is a leading omnichannel customer engagement platform that helps brands connect to their customers in real-time via hyper-personalized communications across email, web, mobile, social, and other channels.

name: IVC Evidensia
description: IVC Evidensia is the world’s largest independent veterinary services company, with market-leading positions in Europe and Canada, an extensive network of clinics/hospitals, and comprehensive pet e-commerce and telemedicine offerings.

name: Jio Platforms
description: Jio is the #1 broadband connectivity provider in India and also delivers an ecosystem of leading digital services applications on a single platform.

name: Khazna Data Centers
description: Khazna Data Centers is the largest hyperscale wholesale data center provider in the Middle East and North Africa.

name: Klarna
description: Klarna is a leading online shopping platform and largest global provider of “buy now, pay later” services. The company has a global reach, connecting its merchant partners to millions of consumers via integrated e-commerce check-out solutions and Klarna’s proprietary mobile app.

name: Koubei
description: Koubei provides mobile solutions for brick-and-mortar businesses to capture growing consumption in China. It allows users to look for local merchants, place orders, conduct payments and write reviews from directly within the Alipay app. Koubei was established in 2015 by Alibaba Group and Ant Financial Services Group, and has since merged with Ele.me.

name: LEARFIELD
description: LEARFIELD represents college athletic departments and other conferences and competitions in the monetization of their multimedia and licensing rights. The company also provides ancillary services such as access to concessions and ticket sales, fan engagement, communication expertise and campus-wide sponsorship development.

name: LightBox
description: LightBox is a leading real estate information and technology platform that facilitates transparency, efficiency, insight, and prediction for real estate investment and location analytics. LightBox’s customers include commercial and government agencies requiring definitive real estate data and powerful workflow solutions, including brokers, developers, investors, lenders, insurers, technology providers, environmental consultants, and valuation professionals.

name: Locaweb
description: Locaweb is Brazil’s largest provider of webhosting, cloud computing, and SaaS applications to small and medium businesses. The Company offers a full suite of services to help businesses establish and grow their Internet presence, including web hosting, cloud servers, domain registration, e-mail accounts, e-mail marketing, and eCommerce.

name: Madison Square Garden Sports
description: Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. (MSG Sports) is a leading professional sports company, with a collection of assets that includes two of the most globally recognized franchises, the New York Knicks (NBA) and the New York Rangers (NHL).

name: MCI
description: MCI was a telecommunications company, previously known as WorldCom, which was acquired by Verizon Communications and integrated into Verizon Business in 2006.

name: Mercury Healthcare
description: Mercury Healthcare, formerly known as Healthgrades, is an enterprise-wide software, technology and data platform for health systems that leverages advanced analytics and insights from patient and provider data to build a connected consumer experience across all physical and digital touchpoints for the nation’s health systems.

name: Mercury Payment Systems
description: Mercury Payment Systems became one of the fastest growing merchant acquirers in North America, creating and delivering benefits through a unique, value-added network of integrated point of sale software developers, resellers, and merchants.

name: Mirakl
description: Mirakl is a leading provider of SaaS marketplace platforms that enable B2B and B2C businesses to launch and grow enterprise marketplaces and seamlessly onboard sellers.

name: Mission Pet Health
description: Mission Pet Health is a leading U.S. veterinary services organization dedicated to reimagining excellence in veterinary care through world-class support for hospital teams and improved pet health outcomes.

name: Motorola Solutions
description: Motorola Solutions creates mission-critical communication solutions and services for more than 100,000 public safety and commercial customers, including local, state and national public safety agencies as well as businesses in industries such as utilities, mining and transportation. Its portfolio includes devices used by professionals in the field, problem-solving software that drives effectiveness, mission-critical systems for command centers, network infrastructure and a range of services.

name: MultiPlan
description: MultiPlan grew as the leading and most comprehensive provider of healthcare cost management solutions in North America, delivering transaction-based services to insurers, health plan administrators, and other payers of healthcare services, as well as to its national network of medical providers.

name: N-Able
description: N-able, Inc. is a global provider of cloud-based software solutions for Managed Service Providers (MSPs). N-able’s portfolio of security, automation, and backup and recovery solutions are purpose-built for MSPs to monitor, manage, and protect their end-customer IT systems, data, and networks. N-able was spun-off from SolarWinds into a standalone public company in 2021.

name: Nasdaq
description: The NASDAQ OMX Group became the world’s largest exchange company, with over 3,800 listed companies, delivering trading, exchange technology and public company services across six continents.

name: Network General / NetScout
description: NetScout, which acquired Network General, provides application and network performance management products, serving enterprise communities, government agencies, and telecommunications service providers.

name: New Zealand Rugby
description: New Zealand Rugby (NZR) is the governing body of rugby union in New Zealand. It controls all of the country’s international teams and domestic club leagues, including some of the world’s most successful sports teams – the All Blacks, the Black Ferns, and the All Blacks Sevens. Silver Lake’s investment is through New Zealand Rugby Commercial, a commercial entity which houses all revenue-generating assets of NZR, as well as through a partnership with NZR and the New Zealand Rugby Players Association to invest in rugby-related opportunities globally.

name: Nobao Renewable Energy
description: Nobao made its mark as a leading provider of fully integrated clean technology management solutions in China utilizing ground source heat pump (GSHP) technologies.

name: Noom
description: Noom is a leading digital health company that combines technology solutions with cognitive behavioral change techniques to deliver long-term positive health outcomes. While initially focused on weight loss, Noom is leveraging its platform to address new categories of chronic conditions and behavioral health.

name: NortonLifeLock
description: NortonLifeLock, formerly known as Symantec prior to the sale of Symantec’s enterprise security business to Broadcom, is a leading global provider of consumer cyber safety solutions.

name: NXP
description: NXP is a provider of semiconductors, system solutions, and software for identification applications, automotive applications, mobile phones, and a wide range of other electronic devices.

name: Oak View Group
description: Oak View Group is a premier provider of sports and live entertainment venue services. It manages and advises venues on sponsorship, security, booking and other matters. It also oversees the development of world-class arenas across the U.S. and operates leading industry trade publications Pollstar and Venues Now.

name: Omio
description: Omio is a travel platform that allows customers to search and book trains, buses and flights across Europe. Partnering with over 500 European transport operators, Omio provides a single and integrated source of travel information through its simple mobile booking tool.

name: Opera Solutions
description: Opera Solutions is a leading provider of “big data” enterprise analytics software and services. Focused on the emerging analytics-as-a-service market, the Company offers solutions across multiple domains including financial services, procurement, credit & fraud, government, healthcare, and marketing.

name: Outspoken
description: Outspoken grew as a SaaS-based mobile marketing platform for enterprise customers with market leading capabilities in SMS, MMS and Video.

name: Peloton
description: Peloton is a leading provider of mission-critical well data management software to oil and gas companies around the world. Peloton’s products are used across a well’s lifecycle including drilling, completion, production, and land administration. Today, more than 450 oil and gas clients worldwide rely on Peloton technology to equip their stakeholders with the tools and information necessary to manage, simplify and optimize their operations.

name: Plaid
description: Plaid is on a mission to “democratize financial services” by giving consumers more control over their financial data. The Company’s APIs and infrastructure platform provides connectivity for more than 4,000 FinTech Apps and over 11,000 financial institutions, enabling developers to create best of breed financial products that consumers can adopt and access seamlessly.

name: Power-One
description: Power-One built and grew two primary businesses: one, a leading supplier of power conversion and power management systems; the other, the leading provider of inverters for alternative energy production. Power-One was acquired by ABB.

name: PrimeSense
description: PrimeSense became a leader in high performance, 3D vision and gesture recognition solutions with solutions to allow users to interact with devices in a simple and intuitive manner. PrimeSense was acquired by Apple.

name: ProService
description: ProService is a leading specialty provider of comprehensive HR outsourcing services, helping SMB employers manage time-consuming and complex HR tasks such as payroll, benefits, insurance, compliance, administrative, and risk management services.

name: Qualtrics
description: Qualtrics is a best-in-class cloud software vendor that has pioneered the enterprise software category of Experience Management (“XM”). Qualtrics’ XM Platform is a mission-critical software system that gives organizations a powerful set of tools to design and improve customer, employee, product and brand experiences.

name: Quorum Software
description: Quorum Software is a leading provider of software and services to manage operational, administrative, financial and transactional business processes for energy, renewables and natural resource industry segments. It was acquired by Thoma Bravo.

name: RAC
description: RAC is a leading automotive breakdown recovery provider in the UK. It has a growing portfolio of consumer digital mobility and driving services across the vehicle lifecycle, and is generating large data sets for new use cases.

name: Red Ventures
description: Red Ventures operates a leading portfolio of influential brands, digital platforms, and strategic partnerships that work together to connect millions of people with expert advice.

name: Relativity
description: Relativity is the industry leader in eDiscovery and Legal Data Intelligence. Its software helps users organize data, discover the truth and act on it.

name: Reliance Retail
description: Reliance Retail is the largest retail business in India. The company is leveraging its supply chain, distribution network, and technology solutions through the JioMart application to provide eCommerce capabilities and digital procurement to small, unorganized merchants throughout the country.

name: Renovate America
description: Renovate America grew as a technology-enabled provider of financing for energy- and water-efficient home improvements, helping homeowners save money and reduce energy and water consumption in their homes, saving more than $1.7 billion in estimated future energy costs and more than 1.6 billion gallons of water.

name: Riverstone Networks
description: Riverstone Networks was a provider of routers and switches for metropolitan services, Internet service providers (ISPs), and content and application providers. All of Riverstone Networks products were geared towards IP over Ethernet and were multilayer switches (or switch-routers), specialized in MPLS VPNs.

name: Root
description: Root is a leading auto insurtech platform, disrupting the ecosystem through its application of mobile-based telematics. Root aims to revolutionize and simplify personal insurance with a pricing model based upon its unique segmentation of risk and a modern customer experience.

name: Sabre
description: Sabre Holdings provides technology-enabled travel distribution services to travel agencies, consumers, and suppliers through its Travel Network, Travelocity, and Sabre Solutions business units.

name: Seagate
description: Seagate Technology crafts the Seagate datasphere, helping to maximize humanity’s potential by innovating world-class, precision-engineered data storage and management solutions with a focus on sustainable partnerships. A global technology leader for more than 40 years, the company has shipped over three billion terabytes of data capacity.

name: Sensata Technologies
description: Sensata Technologies is a market-leading supplier of sensor and control products to a diversified set of end-markets including automotive, industrial, aerospace, appliance and heating, ventilation & air conditioning (HVAC).

name: SenseTime
description: SenseTime is a leading artificial intelligence company that develops computer vision and deep learning technologies.

name: Serena
description: Serena became the leading pure play provider of Application Lifecycle Management for the Enterprise, with 29 offices in 14 countries, dedicated to helping IT capitalize on its software development initiatives.

name: ServiceMax
description: ServiceMax is the global leader in cloud-based software for service execution management, offering tools that improve the productivity of field service technicians and mobile deskless workers. The company serves complex, equipment-centric enterprises across dozens of industries including healthcare, industrial manufacturing, and oil & gas.

name: Shadowbox Studios
description: Shadowbox Studios develops, owns, and operates state-of-the-art soundstages for film and media production, and provides a range of on-site support services for clients.

name: Silae
description: Silae is a provider of SaaS payroll and HR solutions, in partnership with its network of CPA and HR outsourcing partners. The company’s cloud-native products enable full automation of complex payroll and HR processes, ensuring full adherence with labour and tax regulations and facilitating seamless communication and data exchange between outsourcing partners and customers.

name: Skype
description: Skype is a leading global Internet communications company providing software used by millions of individuals and businesses to make free video and in-network voice calls as well as paid calls to standard telephones and to send text messages. Skype was acquired by Microsoft.

name: SMART Global Holdings
description: SMART Global Holdings is a leading independent developer and manufacturer of DRAM and Flash-based modules and subsystems for computing, communications, embedded, and defense applications. The Company operates in Brazil, Malaysia, the UK, and the US.

name: SMART Storage Systems
description: SMART Storage Systems is a leading provider of current and next-generation enterprise solid-state storage products. The Company delivers its solutions to a broad customer base in the enterprise storage, enterprise server, data center, defense, and industrial markets. SMART Storage Systems is part of the SMART Modular Technologies family of global companies.

name: SoFi
description: SoFi is a mobile-first, consumer finance company offering fully integrated checking, savings, brokerage, lending, and other financial products to help users achieve their financial goals. SoFi operates a nationally chartered bank and financial technology infrastructure spanning digital core banking and payment processing platforms.

name: Software AG
description: Software AG operates two standalone businesses: ARIS, a market-leading business process intelligence solution for enabling agentic AI; and A&N, a high performance non-relational mainframe database platform.

name: SolarCity
description: SolarCity grew as a leading designer, installer, and financer of solar energy systems for residential, commercial, and government customers. It was acquired by Tesla.

name: SolarWinds
description: SolarWinds is a leading provider of powerful and affordable hybrid IT management software to customers worldwide from Fortune 500® enterprises to small businesses, government agencies, and educational institutions.

name: Spansion
description: Spansion, merged with Cypress Semiconductor, made its mark as the leading provider of embedded flash memory technology and solutions with the company’s flash memory integrated into a broad range of products including automotive electronics, telecom and network equipment, consumer electronics, and servers.

name: Splunk
description: Splunk is an industry-leading software platform that enables customers to collect, index, search, monitor, and analyze data at enterprise scale across security, IT, and DevOps use cases.

name: Spreadtrum
description: Spreadtrum Communications, now UNISOC, is a fabless semiconductor company that develops baseband and RF processor solutions for the wireless communications market, combining its semiconductor design expertise with its software development capabilities to deliver highly-integrated baseband processors with multimedia functionality and power management.

name: Stripe
description: Stripe was founded in 2010 to increase the GDP of the internet. It offers a developer-centric, API-driven payments platform that simplifies payment infrastructure complexity and enables the next generation of e-commerce business models, in addition to a growing suite of ancillary commerce enablement and financial services products, such as fraud management, analytics and SMB lending.

name: SubmitOrder
description: SubmitOrder made its mark as a provider of outsourcing services, offering customers services to support web applications, catalogs, and kiosk transactions, maintaining call and distribution centers throughout the eastern United States.

name: SunGard
description: SunGard, now part of FIS, grew as a global provider of software and processing solutions and business continuity services through its four divisions: Availability Services, Financial Systems, Public Sector and K-12 Education.

name: TAL Education Group
description: TAL is a leading education technology platform in China, offering tutoring across core academic subjects for K-12 students through online and offline large or small classes, and premium one-to-one services.

name: Talend
description: Talend is a leading provider of open source software for data management, offering a full suite of tools for data integration, data quality, master data management, and application integration. These products help corporate IT departments address the exponential growth in the volume and heterogeneity of data they need to manage across systems and applications.

name: Tandberg
description: Tandberg, now part of Cisco, grew as the leading provider of videoconferencing equipment worldwide.

name: TeamSystem

Founded in 1988, Hobbs is profitable and creates entry level jobs in installation, service, transportation and manufacturing.

name: Binti
description: Binti is a govtech software company transforming one of America’s most consequential public systems: child welfare. This is a system where too many kids fall through the cracks: foster children account for 1/3 of homeless youth and young adults, experience PTSD at twice the rate of combat veterans, are at significantly higher risk of being exploited in sex trafficking, and have a 40% chance of incarceration by age 26. Binti has built the leading purpose-built software platform for child welfare, modernizing everything from foster parent licensing and family-finding to service referrals and case management, and now serves more than 550 agencies across 37 states.

name: BioSurplus
description: BioSurplus provides turnkey services for managing the entire life cycle of laboratory instruments in the life sciences industry. The company designs and implements solutions for every stage of the laboratory equipment life cycle including buying and selling used laboratory equipment, equipment refurbishing, online auctions, inventory management software and service & repair of existing assets.

name: Brains & Motion Education
description: Brains & Motion Education (BAM!) is a tech-enabled company unlocking the potential of students year-round through summer camp, after-school, and structured enrichment programs. By empowering the next generation with world-class STEM, Arts, and Sports programs, BAM fosters a lifelong love for learning, shaping well-rounded individuals who are not just ready for tomorrow but thriving in the present. To date, BAM has served 1,150+ schools and 93,000 students with 4,600 programs delivered.

name: Brightside Academy
description: Brightside Academy (formerly Allegheny Child Care Academy) is dedicated to providing high quality child care services in underserved urban communities. Brightside’s child care network extends to several states, and its services are available to families who qualify for state and federal child care subsidies.

name: CampusLogic
description: CampusLogic is reinventing educational pathways and changing the way students access billions of dollars each year in scholarships and grants for college. CampusLogic empowers students to earn “micro-scholarships” throughout high school for their individual achievements, creating a more transparent and motivational process while enabling the students to see the guaranteed minimum amount of aid they’ll receive from an institution long before they apply.

name: Carrum Health
description: Carrum Health was founded in 2014 with a mission to “match human need with medical excellence” through a model that is beneficial to organizations, employees and healthcare providers. Carrum achieves this by connecting thoughtful and progressive self-insured employers with local and national Center of Excellence healthcare providers under bundled payment arrangements. Doing so aligns healthcare provider incentives with quality performance, resulting in dramatic improvement in patient experiences and care outcomes. In addition, both employers and their employees see significant cost savings.

name: Catalant
description: Catalant is a software platform that helps companies to execute on strategy faster. It allows organizations to set strategic objectives, understand and assign internal talent resources, track execution with a more transparent workflow, and flexibly access over 50,000 Catalant experts to execute on those company goals.

name: Cecelia Health
description: The mission of Cecelia Health (formerly Fit4D) is to improve the lives of people living with diabetes worldwide. Cecelia delivers scalable and effective patient programs through an optimized mix of its technology platform and human-based touch points. The Cecelia Health clinical team, comprised of dietitians, exercise physiologists, nurses and social workers, many of whom are also certified diabetes educators (CDEs), focuses on empowering people with diabetes to live rich, healthy and fulfilling lives. The company’s Fortune 500 clients include pharmaceutical, payer, provider and wellness companies. Cecelia Health has also engaged in numerous joint initiatives with the Juvenile Diabetes Research Foundation, American Diabetes Association and Diabetes Research Institute.

name: ChartSpan
description: ChartSpan offers a full-service Chronic Care Management (CCM) solution for healthcare providers (particularly Federally Qualified Health Centers and Rural Health Centers) that want to implement care CMS-reimbursed coordination services for their Medicare patients, but do not have the capacity to build the program in-house. Rolled out initially in 2015, CCM is a Medicare program designed to compensate clinicians who manage the care of their chronically ill Medicare patients between office visits via care coordination services. While CCM is attractive to providers and health systems as a way to drive additional patient revenue, improve patient care, and reduce long term costs, many providers do not have the staff, expertise, and/or resources to build out and provide CCM services themselves. ChartSpan is one of the largest CCM vendors in the US today.

name: City Soft
description: CitySoft provides a web-based software platform – Community Enterprise – to social sector organizations. Reflecting the needs of its clients, Community Enterprise is affordable, easy-to-use, and open source. CitySoft, along with its wide range of professional services partners, is focused on providing the best enterprise platform possible to social sector organizations.

name: Civitas Learning
description: Civitas Learning brings together the best of new technology, design thinking and data science to the higher education market in its mission to help more college students learn well and finish strong. Using a cloud-based, predictive analytics platform and engaging applications, Civitas Learning helps partner institutions bring deep insights to decision makers and personalized, real-time recommendations directly to the front lines for students, faculty and advisors to measurably improve student learning, persistence and graduation.

name: CleanScapes
description: CleanScapes, based in Seattle, Washington, provides sustainable solid waste and recycling collection and comprehensive StreetScape management services to municipalities, commercial properties, business improvement districts and stadiums in Washington, Oregon and California. The company has pioneered environmental and civic strategies to clean up and strengthen urban neighborhoods, provide excellent employment opportunities and reduce the environmental footprint of their clients.

name: Community Energy
description: Community Energy, since its inception in 1999, has led renewable energy development and the construction of more than 1,400 MW of wind and solar generating facilities across the United States. Community Energy uses a mix of utility off-take approaches, renewable energy marketing, new financing structures, development expertise and public policy support to accelerate the deployment of renewable energy technologies at scale. An industry pioneer, Community Energy developed the first wind farms in New Jersey and New Hampshire, as well as the first 100 MW+ utility-scale solar projects in Colorado, Minnesota and Virginia.

name: Cooks Venture
description: Cooks Venture sells a proprietary heirloom breed of chicken that is healthier and more biologically balanced than conventional breeds, resulting in both significantly better animal welfare and strikingly superior taste. The chickens’ slower-growing nature, pasture-raised environments and regenerative agriculture relationships provide additional differentiating attributes in the poultry market. Cooks was established by a group of farmers, cooks and food professionals who decided to build a new food system animal-by-animal, plant-by-plant, meal-by-meal.

name: DDF
description: DDF is a skin care products company and was acquired by North Castle Partners.

name: DeweyLearn
description: DeweyLearn’s core premise is that traditional multiple-choice and written assessments fail in measuring critical skills, and that manual evaluation eats into time instructors and clinicians could spend on higher-value instruction and care, a problem that is made worse by a shortage of qualified human evaluators. DeweyLearn is a multi-modal AI platform that analyzes video, image, audio, and text that evaluates learning and competency across K-12, higher education, clinical settings, and workforce training.

name: DUOS
description: DUOS partners with Medicare Advantage plans to help them better engage and connect their members to covered supplemental benefits, government programs, and community-based resources to address unresolved medical and aging-related needs such as meal deliveries, transportation to/from appointments, and medication pick-ups. The company leverages its team of trained virtual personal assistants (called “Duos”) and its proprietary technology platform to target under-engaged plan members, inform them of available covered benefits under their plan, and then connect them with the optimal choices based on their personalized needs. In doing so, DUOS’s mission is to help empower older adults to live as healthily and independently as possible.

name: Easy Metrics
description: Easy Metrics is a SaaS-based business intelligence platform that helps companies identify and optimize their labor costs. The company’s labor management system delivers 40% productivity improvements while providing significantly enhanced insights into labor-intensive activities. Cost savings are often shared with employees, producing both economic and job quality benefits.

name: Ed Map
description: ED MAP was a content strategy and logistics company simplifying the discovery, adoption, management, and delivery of quality educational content to help institutions lower the cost of education and improve outcomes.

name: Elemeno Health
description: Elemeno Health provides clinicians with a unique “playbook in your pocket” for enhancing patient care and executing day-to-day tasks efficiently. The microsolutions powered by Elemeno feature content that is accessible, digestible and customized to each hospital department’s preferences. The company’s offering has resulted in increased nurse engagement, with associated improvements in nurse satisfaction and retention; streamlined orientations, with shortened time to value for new hires; and improved care consistency, with decreases in errors and patient harm.

name: Ellipsis Health
description: Ellipsis Health has pioneered an AI-powered virtual agent, Sage, that automates care management while maintaining personalized, empathetic communication with every patient. By offloading routine check-ins to AI agents, hospitals and health plans can scale critical touch points for health monitoring, save costs, and free up clinical staff to operate at the top of their licenses.

description: ENTOUCH Controls provides SaaS-based energy management systems (EMS) for retail and restaurant chains. The company’s ENTOUCH 360°™ service platform integrates turnkey installation, management analytics, issue ticketing and resolution tracking that detects HVAC maintenance issues, optimizes performance and lowers energy costs for national chains, franchise owners, schools and offices. ENTOUCH’s system takes advantage of wireless and M2M (machine-to-machine) technology to deliver immediate energy savings and ROI while offering enterprise level analytics and controls. The company provides a cost-effective EMS solution to small commercial facilities with robust functionality previously only available to large commercial buildings.

name: EvCo

name: FieldView
description: FieldView Solutions is an enterprise software company that provides data center managers with a solution to enhance capacity planning, energy management and risk mitigation for critical assets. FieldView’s customers include a number of leading global financial services companies and other Fortune 500 businesses.

name: Foxfire
description: Foxfire provides production management services, including graphic design, printing, packaging, warehousing, fulfillment, invoicing and collection. Foxfire specializes in assisting large corporations and retail chains in outsourcing printing, fulfillment and signage functions.

name: Graphika
description: Graphika uses AI and data science to understand online networks and identify coordinated disinformation efforts, some of which are led by foreign adversaries or special interest groups. Graphika’s customers include Fortune 500 companies, government agencies, and nonprofits. Graphika helps to bring transparency to the internet by uncovering manipulative online influence operations, a critical task amid the rise of generative AI tools and the propagation of synthetic media.

name: groSolar
description: groSolar is a leading large commercial and utility scale solar engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) firm with megawatt+ projects across the US. The company serves the 1–30MW solar market, with experience spanning a broad spectrum including design and build applications atop brownfields, landfills, water/ waste water treatment plants and manufacturing facilities.

name: Home Bistro
description: Home Bistro is a direct-mail frozen food company. Home Bistro was acquired by DineWise in June 2009.

name: HYLA
description: HYLA Mobile (formerly eRecyclingCorps) is one of the world’s leading providers of mobile device trade-in and reuse solutions. Since its founding in 2009, HYLA Mobile has worked to extend the life cycle of mobile devices to build economic opportunity and enable information access for new users. HYLA operates across four continents and has completed more than 50 million mobile device trade-ins since inception. The high quality, cleared devices are resold to consumers around the world, extending access to affordable, high-quality wireless technology in developed and emerging markets. Helping to protect our planet, the company has diverted over 18 million pounds of e-waste from landfills.

name: Intechra
description: Intechra has been a standard-setting leader in the IT asset disposition industry (ITAD), processing millions of retired electronic tools in more than 20 countries. Acquired by Arrow Electronics in February of 2010, Intechra, along with other IT asset disposition market leaders, integrated into the Arrow Electronics brand and in October of 2012, introduced Arrow Value Recovery Solutions. Intechra provides end-to-end IT asset retirement solutions including data security and destruction, redeployment, remarketing, lease return, logistics management, legislative compliance, risk management and environmentally responsible recycling of every type of IT equipment.

name: Interplay Learning
description: Interplay Learning develops and delivers scalable and effective training for hands-on skilled workforce populations, using Virtual Reality and 3D simulation. The company provides simulation training in the HVAC, Electrical, Energy Auditing, Solar Install, Manufacturing, and Construction Codes industries, and offers both off-the-shelf and custom solutions to solve difficult workforce training challenges.

name: Iron Sheepdog
description: Iron Sheepdog is a technology platform focused on short haul trucking. The company’s software enables efficient management of dump trucks and other short haul fleets through dispatching, GPS tracking, real-time communication, digital ticketing, data analytics, reporting, hauler payments, and automated invoicing. The company also operates a virtual exchange marketplace for the movement of construction materials, which maximizes truck utilization by matching backhauls and eliminating empty miles. The cumulative impacts of these supply chain improvements include: fewer wasted miles in short haul trucking; empowerment of small businesses in the industry to scale and prosper, many of which are disadvantaged business enterprises (DBEs); greater transparency; and increased safety.

name: Jopwell
description: Jopwell connects Black, Latino, and Native American professionals with career opportunities at leading companies. The company helps businesses across a range of industries to address their diversity recruiting objectives.

LeadGenius is a charter member and signer of the Good Work Code.

name: Lineage Logistics
description: Lineage is the largest cold storage and temperature-controlled logistics company globally with over 480 facilities in 20 countries across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific totaling over 3 billion cubic feet of capacity. Approximately 30% of temperature-controlled food products in the U.S. and nearly 10% globally travel through Lineage’s warehouse network. Lineage’s industry-leading expertise in end-to-end logistical solutions, its unrivalled real estate network, and its use of technology combine to promote food safety, increase distribution efficiency, advance sustainability, minimize supply chain waste, and help feed the world. Headquartered in Novi, MI, Lineage employs over 26,000 people worldwide.

name: Lium
description: Lium is building AI models that natively process scientific data to provide powerful, generalizable insights across a variety of applications that rely on science for breakthroughs and progress, such as environmental monitoring, climate science, methane leak detection, advanced materials, medical imaging, and pharmaceuticals.

name: Living Earth
description: Living Earth is a leading composting and organic material products company with operations in both Texas and Tennessee. The company’s 32 facilities across the two states collect yard waste, tree trimmings and other organic materials from landscapers, residents and municipal collections. Living Earth provides a more sustainable and cost efficient option for disposing of these materials than local landfills. The organic waste is ground, mixed and composted to produce a range of soil mixes, organic amendments, mulches and composts that are of high quality and demanded by regional landscapers, retailers and residents. These products are sold in bulk and bag form, along with some other landscaping products.

name: Lōvu
description: Lōvu is a digital maternal wellness platform that supports obstetricians by serving as an extension of their offices to provide personalized care to mothers in between traditional prenatal and postpartum office visits. Lōvu pairs this with access to a curated, best-in-breed marketplace of third-party digital vendors for specialty care needs (e.g., behavioral health, lactation consultants, pelvic floor rehab, etc.) to create a scalable end-to-end care model that can address the growing maternal health crisis in the US by better serving all mothers regardless of their insurance coverage.

MediaMath has been named repeatedly by Glassdoor as one of the best places to work.

name: MedPage Today
description: MedPage Today is a healthcare media company that delivers breaking medical news to physicians and patients. Healthcare professionals who read MedPage’s Internet-based content and pass a subsequent test receive continuing medical education credits from the University of Pennsylvania School of Medicine, which is an active partner in producing MedPage’s content.

name: Mercado
description: Mercado is an online platform that automates the first mile of the import supply chain. Mercado’s vision is to provide customers with the same type of modern and frictionless buying experience that they provide to their own customers by leveraging the platform’s 70+ procurement, ordering, and shipping features. By helping businesses digitally track, change, and manage their orders from the moment a purchase order is placed, Mercado is perfectly positioned to bring the world of international trade into the digital age and to provide importers with increased visibility into their suppliers.

name: mPulse Mobile
description: mPulse Mobile’s solutions help healthcare consumers and organizations achieve better health outcomes by increasing engagement and improving communication through meaningful, interactive dialogue primarily through text messaging. Combining technology, analytics and industry expertise, mPulse delivers tailored mobile engagement programs that help healthcare organizations activate their consumers to adopt healthy behaviors. The company supports bi-directional and AI/chatbot communication interactions for providers, plans, pharmaceutical and wellness organizations helping establish personalized connections with their consumers.

name: NewEdge Power
description: NewEdge Power identifies and develops sites with the potential to host next-generation power infrastructure. The company’s initial projects focus on utility-scale battery storage, community solar and utility-scale solar development in the United States. NewEdge’s team consists of industry veterans who have been instrumental in developing more than 13.3 gigawatts of power projects and raising more than $3 billion for renewable energy companies to date.

name: Nextpower
description: Nextracker designs and manufactures innovative tracking systems for the global utility-scale solar market. The company’s products reduce costs and increase yield for solar project developers, resulting in solar energy production that is more cost-competitive with fossil fuel energy sources. Bringing together some of the most experienced professionals in the industry with over one gigawatt and many years of tracker installation experience, Nextracker is uniquely positioned to drive future technology innovation for solar power production.

name: Novinium
description: Novinium has patented processes for rejuvenating aged underground power cables. The company’s technology extends the useful life of these cables by another 20 to 40 years, reusing them in situ. Cable rejuvenation is faster, safer and more environmentally friendly than cable replacement. The process saves up to 70% over the cost of cable replacement, allowing utilities to address a significantly larger portion of high risk cable, providing a much higher impact on improving grid reliability.

name: Nuclearn
description: Nuclearn builds AI solutions for the nuclear power industry, with a focus on automation of regulatory processes, knowledge management, and operational efficiency within the operating nuclear fleet. The company was founded by veterans of the industry to help address the nuclear workforce crisis, where one quarter of the workforce is approaching retirement in the coming years. Founded in 2021, the company has established an initial presence at over 50% of the North American nuclear fleet. By enhancing safe operation and extending the lifetime of existing nuclear plants, Nuclearn is enabling production of large-scale, carbon-free power to meet rising electricity needs.

name: Optoro
description: Optoro’s mission is to be the leading market solution for returned and excess goods, providing superior value for buyers and sellers across the world. Through their cloud-based, multi-channel selling technology, online remarketing expertise and full suite of business intelligence tools, Optoro offers its clients the optimal solution for managing and selling their returned and excess inventory. Since its founding, Optoro’s focus has been on using cutting edge technology and access to the world’s online marketplaces to drive higher recovery rates, quicker turn-times and more transparency for clients’ goods.

name: Origin
description: Origin is the largest specialized provider of pelvic floor and women’s health physical therapy in the US today. Origin’s hybrid care model of both in-clinic and telehealth visits serves women across all 50 states and all stages of life and medical conditions (e.g., pregnancy and postpartum, incontinence, overactive bladder, and general pelvic pain/discomfort.)

name: Perishable Shipping Solutions
description: PSS provides direct-to-consumer e-commerce fulfillment of perishable food & beverage products for small and mid-sized consumer brands. PSS enables its customers to focus on building their brands and achieving growth rather than managing backend logistics. PSS saves its customers money while providing a scalable supply chain solution at service levels difficult to achieve on their own. Headquartered in Youngstown, OH, PSS employs over 60 individuals in facilities located in economically distressed areas of Youngstown and Reno, NV.

name: Portfolium
description: Portfolium’s ePortfolio network helps millions of students and alumni from hundreds of partner institutions manage their skills and launch their careers. By giving students opportunities to show what they know, Portfolium facilitates jobs for college students, allowing a more inclusive population of talented individuals to be discovered by employers through what it calls “evidence-based” recruiting. Portfolium’s Tale ntMatch helps recruiters match jobs to direct evidence of skills, while looking beyond students’ GPAs, majors and school reputations.

name: PosiGen
description: PosiGen is a residential solar platform that makes solar energy and energy efficiency upgrades available to all homeowners, regardless of income or credit score. The company primarily services low-to-moderate income (LMI) customers, enabling both energy savings and carbon emissions reductions.

name: Preclick
description: Preclick is a photo organizing and sharing company. Preclick was acquired by SmileBox in September 2009.

name: RealWinWin
description: RealWinWin, Inc. is an energy management and software company servicing the commercial real estate management sector. RealWinWin combines building-specific information such as utility consumption, square footage and retrofit costs, along with tenant lease data and property appraisal methods to generate energy-saving projects with positive ROIs. The company offers a sophisticated mix of building-specific energy services from basic energy rebate audits using F.I.N.D.(tm) to high-value energy and lease analysis using NOI Builder ™.

name: Respondology
description: Respondology reduces toxic and spam content from the comments sections of the world’s largest social media platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. The company leverages its proprietary software and trained moderators to classify and remove malicious comments on behalf of customers who range from Fortune 100 companies, sports franchises, and marketing agencies to small D2C companies, individuals, and nonprofits. To date, Respondology has moderated tens of millions of comments across 22 languages.

name: Revalue Nature
description: Revalue Nature turbocharges work performed by leading nature-based carbon project developers around the world. The company does this by streamlining development processes, providing unrivaled spatial intelligence, and unlocking favorable project financings. The company was founded to rethink carbon projects from the ground up and deliver a fundamental step change in project integrity. Revalue Nature’s projects help address climate change, generate biodiversity, support ecosystems, and drive community economic impact.

name: Rhithm
description: Rhithm offers an innovative social emotional learning (SEL) and mental health tool for K-12 schools. With Rhithm, educators, counselors, and district leaders can collect, evaluate, and monitor student response data to actively address and support student well-being, using Rhithm’s ready-made SEL assessments and interventions that are engaging and tailored to each individual student’s needs.

name: ROOM
description: ROOM provides sustainable and flexible solutions for the modern workplace that are designed to foster workforce wellness, safety and productivity and reduce the need for traditional fixed construction. The company’s initial product is a soundproof phone booth that provides a silent space to escape for a phone call, meditation or simply to focus quietly. ROOM is actively developing and launching new modular office solutions, including meeting rooms, wall partitions and mother’s rooms, and is addressing multiple impact themes including Future of Work, employee wellness and sustainability.

Rustic Crust sells its branded pizza products nationwide in natural food stores, traditional supermarkets and club stores. Rustic Crust also acquired an exclusive license for the American Flatbread frozen pizza brand in 2010. American Flatbread is the leading natural frozen flatbread pizza on the market.

name: Ryla
description: Ryla is a global customer call center company. Ryla was acquired by Alorica in April 2010.

name: Salvage Direct
description: Salvage Direct facilitates the efficient sale of salvage vehicles from auto insurers to licensed vehicle dismantlers via on-line auction. The company also provides supporting salvage management services to the auto insurance industry.

name: SchooLinks
description: SchooLinks offers a college and career readiness platform that empowers students and families to have ownership over their education, careers, and post-secondary plans. The AI-powered product replaces the process traditionally managed by counseling departments, and provides an easy-to-use platform for meaningful interactions among school administrators, students and families, and potential employers.

name: SeamlessDocs
description: SeamlessDocs is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company focused on bringing government paperwork and workflows into the digital and mobile age. Hundreds of state and local governments in the United States rely on SeamlessDocs to conduct business online through digital forms, e-signatures, online payments and workflow automation. SeamlessDocs’ products increase governmental operating efficiency and provide a more convenient and transparent means for citizens to interact with their local and state governments.

name: SelecTech
description: SelecTech produces proprietary flooring from recycled scrap using a unique injection molding process. SelecTech’s FreeStyle commercial floor tiles are installed by several nationwide retail chains.

name: ServiceChannel
description: ServiceChannel provides online tools that empower contractors to collaborate more effectively with facilities managers. Leading retailers like Apple, Gap, Best Buy, Coach and Bare Escentuals engage ServiceChannel’s Web-based solutions to locate contractors, place maintenance requests, track projects and process payments. ServiceChannel processes over $3 billion in maintenance work annually in 100,000 store locations. More than 50,000 service contractor companies representing hundreds of thousands of individual contractors have been trained on ServiceChannel’s systems.

name: ShipMonk
description: ShipMonk provides multi-channel order fulfillment services and inventory management software to small and midsized (SMB) e-commerce companies. ShipMonk enables SMBs to focus on building their brands and achieving growth rather than managing backend logistics. ShipMonk saves e-commerce companies money while providing a scalable supply chain solution at service levels that are difficult to achieve on their own. ShipMonk employs over 1,000 individuals across facilities in Fort Lauderdale, FL, where its headquarters is based in an economically distressed area, Los Angeles, CA, and Pittston, PA.

name: Solera Health
description: Solera is a personalized preventive health network that connects patients, payers and physicians with non-clinical healthcare providers. Solera helps consolidate highly fragmented programs and services into one integrated network, allowing health plans and medical providers to increase patient participation while lowering associated costs. Solera identifies a “best fit” chronic disease prevention program provider based on an individual’s unique needs and preferences, which has proven to have a significant impact on improved patient outcomes at a fraction of the cost of traditional medical care.

name: Springboard
description: Springboard offers a mentor-guided online learning platform that prepares individuals for in-demand careers. Springboard has experienced immense student enrollment growth and has pioneered a learning model that has enabled thousands of successful career transitions for graduates, 94% of whom secure a job within a year, earning an average salary increase of $26,000. While Springboard courses are taught entirely online, each student benefits from 1:1 personalized mentor support and a network of career experts.

description: Take Command Health offers employers a new model of health care coverage that empowers employees to personalize their health benefits in ways that control costs and improve satisfaction. TemperPack’s proprietary insulated packaging ensures safe delivery in a sustainable manner.

The company is on a mission is to drive solar power prices down below one cent per kilowatt-hour (kWh) and to accelerate deployment in large-scale solar by digitalizing the solar power plant.

name: Think Through Learning
description: Think Through Learning Inc. is an award-winning SaaS math instructional system serving schools and students across the United States. Created by teachers and technologists, its flagship product, Think Through Math (TTM), provides supplemental math instruction and practice to help students in grades 3 through Algebra I prepare for the rigors of the Common Core State Standards, TEKS and next-generation assessments. The company has spent more than a decade solving the problem of math comprehension by integrating adaptive, online instruction with on-demand tutoring. TTM has grown to support more than 2.5 million students in 47 states.

name: Tive
description: Tive is a leading provider of real-time supply chain visibility insights that help logistics professionals actively manage their in-transit shipments’ location and condition. With Tive, shippers, carriers, and logistics service providers (LSPs) eliminate delays, damage, and shipment failures which significantly reduces waste throughout the supply chain. Tive’s solution provides data generated by its industry-leading trackers allowing clients to actively optimize their shipments, improve their customers’ experience, and unlock supply chain insights in an actionable real-time manner. Tive has delivered real-time shipment visibility in more than 200 countries, and helped save thousands of shipments from being delayed, damaged, spoiled, rejected, or lost.
