name: LimFlow
description: LimFlow is a private, venture-backed medical device company transforming the treatment of Critical Limb Ischemia, a growing clinical need in the face of the prevalence of diabetes, heart disease and an aging population. The LimFlow Percutaneous Deep Vein Arterialization (pDVA) System is designed to bypass blocked arteries in the leg and rush oxygenated blood back into the foot. For many patients, restoring perfusion in the lower limbs resolves chronic pain, improves quality of life, promotes wound healing and prevents major amputation.

name: Lysogene
description: Lysogene is a clinical stage pioneering biotechnology company in the field of gene therapy targeting severe genetic pathologies of central nervous system in children. The company went public in 2017 on the Euronext Stock Exchange (FR0013233475 / LYS)

name: Mablink Bioscience
description: Mablink Bioscience is developing the next generation of an emerging class of cancer drugs called antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). Mablink's patented hydrophilic drug-linker technology enables the design of homogenous, plasma-stable next generation ADCs that have high DAR (drug-to-antibody ratio) while retaining excellent pharmacological properties and tolerability.

name: Mainstay Medical
description: Mainstay Medical is developing ReActiv8, an implantable peripheral nerve stimulator system leveraging a novel neurorehabilitation therapy approach to treat chronic, non-specific, low back pain. Chronic low back pain is a major unmet medical problem afflicting millions of people world-wide each year, where conventional therapies have limited effectiveness for the majority of patients. Both the Capital Fund and the Crossover Fund have invested in Mainstay.

name: MaxCyte
description: MaxCyte [MXCT] is a global, clinical-stage, cell-based therapy and life sciences company. As the inventors of the industry standard, non-viral cell-engineering technology, the company helps bring the potential of next-generation cell and gene-editing therapies to life. The company’s technology is currently being deployed by leading drug developers worldwide, including all of the top ten global biopharmaceutical companies. MaxCyte licenses have been granted for more than 100 cell therapy programmes, with more than 70 licensed for clinical use, and the company has now entered into ten clinical/commercial license agreements with leading cell therapy and gene editing developers. MaxCyte was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Gaithersburg, Maryland.

name: May Health
description: May Health (formerly AblaCare) is a clinical-stage medical device company committed to developing treatment options for women living with PCOS. The company is currently investigating its Ovarian Rebalancing™ treatment in clinical studies; Ovarian Rebalancing is a novel approach to PCOS-related fertility that has the potential to be a safe, straightforward option for activating natural ovulation. May Health is led by a team of serial medtech and women’s health entrepreneurs and executives with extensive experience in product development, validation, and launch. The company has raised €10M in a Series A led by Sofinnova Partners and was founded in 2017 by the firm’s medtech acceleration team, Sofinnova MD Start. May Health is headquartered in Paris, France.

name: Mediar Therapeutics
description: Mediar Therapeutics is a biotechnology company pioneering a new approach to fibrosis treatment that halts the disease at a different source – the fibrotic mediators that drive disease progression. Mediar was founded based on a deep understanding of the complex science underlying fibrosis onset and progression. By combining novel targets with reliable, easily detectable blood biomarkers and familiar modalities, Mediar is derisking the path forward for fibrosis therapies in clinical development.

name: Meiogenix
description: Meiogenix has developed an innovative approach to common problems in agriculture, addressing key global food and industrial challenges. The company is applying gene and chromosome editing technologies to accelerate nature's generation of biodiversity through the mixing of parental genomes during plant reproduction. This helps expedite the lengthy process of plant varieties selection and also leads to increased biodiversity, lost during the systematic selection of crops for high yield and long shelf life. The ability to restore a plant's immunity to pests and diseases, and improve quality, taste and flavor in many crops also has the potential to revolutionize the AgriFood Tech sector. Key benefits of the platform include more access to natural food products for customers and less chemicals required in growing food.

name: MetGen
description: METGEN designs and markets novel enzymatic solutions for customers working in bio-based materials. MetGen, founded in 2008 and is based in Kaarina, Finland, creates industrial, highly-active, natural catalysts that accelerate chemical reactions. The company uses advances in genetic engineering and microbiology to adapt enzymes to harsh industrial conditions and to handle a variety of lignocellulosic substrates. MetGen aims to be a widely recognized supplier of industrial enzymes, significantly contributing to the economics and sustainability of process industries such as biofuels and renewable chemicals.

name: Micropep Technologies
description: Micropep Technologies was incorporated in 2016 to build a unique discovery engine to rapidly identify plant bioactive peptides based on a natural, transient and localized regulation mechanism discovered by the company's scientific team. The solutions developed by Micropep unleash the natural potential of plants to help farmers better manage abiotic and biotic stresses, control weed growth and ultimately increase crop yields while preserving the environment.

name: Microphyt
description: Microphyt is a French biotech company that develops, produces and markets microalgae-based natural ingredients. Thanks to a production process that is unique in the market, Microphyt draws on the exceptional potential of microalgae to provide natural, effective and sustainable solutions for the dietary supplement and cosmetic industries. Microphyt currently employs 20 people and has filed 5 different patent families.

name: Mironid
description: Mironid seeks to become the world leader in cell signaling directed therapeutic development. The Glasgow-based company is building a pipeline of drug development programs that are targeted at cAMP degrading phosphodiesterase enzymes. These will generate novel and differentiated therapies for a range of diseases with high unmet medical need.

name: Mission Therapeutics
description: Mission Therapeutics is a specialist pharmaceutical company whose aim is to translate new molecular understandings of human cell biology into drugs that will markedly improve the management of life-threatening diseases, particularly cancer. The company holds and aims to maintain world-leadership in DNA repair and associated molecular mechanisms, particularly those involving enzymes of the ubiquitin pathway. Mission Therapeutics will use its knowledge and proven expertise in targeting these pathways for small-molecule drug discovery to develop new therapeutic agents with wide market potential. These drugs mainly target “Achilles heels” of diseased tissues by exploiting the concept of synthetic-lethality.

name: Mnemo Therapeutics
description: Mnemo is developing powerful cell therapies using a novel target identification engine, stronger T cells and best-in-class manufacturing. The company is accelerating development of the EnfiniT targeting and next generation chimeric antigen receptors (CAR) T cell therapy platform combining pioneering research from Institut Curie and Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK). EnfiniT is a transformational suite of technologies built around a novel epigenetic antigen (E-antigen) discovery engine, able to identify antigens with greater tumor specificity that are completely unique to cancer cells. When combined with EnfiniT’s proprietary set of technologies that increase CAR T cell memory and persistence, they enable a range of therapeutic options that can deliver deeper clinical responses than current cell therapies. Supported with best-in-class, autologous and allogenic cell manufacturing, Mnemo’s EnfiniT platform will be able to overcome the current limitations of CAR T, creating cell therapies that are highly effective and scalable.

name: Moon Surgical
description: Moon Surgical (previously MastOR SAS) is a Paris-based, early-stage medical device company, developing a surgical robot for laparoscopy assistance. It is a privately held portfolio company of Sofinnova Partners, financed through the MD Start III Fund. The core technology is derived from joint research between the ISIR robotics lab at Sorbonne University and Professor Brice Gayet, a world-renowned surgeon and pioneer in minimally-invasive surgery.

name: Movetis
description: Movetis was acquired by Shire in 2010 for €428 million. Movetis focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of drugs for the treatment of diseases in the gastrointestinal (GI) area. It was created by a team of entrepreneurs led by Dirk Reyn as a spin-off from Johnson & Johnson. Its products address GI disorders, such as severe chronic constipation, ascites, pediatric reflux, as well as severe forms of GI motility disorders, including refractory gastro-esophageal reflux disease. Movetis brought to market Resolor, a drug for chronic constipation.

name: Mozart Therapeutics
description: Mozart Therapeutics is focused on developing disease-modifying therapies for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases that work by targeting a novel regulatory immune pathway. The therapeutic focus of Mozart’s lead program is autoimmune mediated gastro-intestinal disorders. The company is headquartered in Seattle, WA.

name: Muna Therapeutics
description: Muna is the combination of two innovative European start-up companies. Muna was founded in 2020 by progranulin pathway thought leaders Professor Simon Glerup and his team from Aarhus University, Denmark, with investor Novo Holdings. Muna developed a strategic partnership on additional targets with Axxam SpA, based in Milan, Italy, which became a minority shareholder. Muna is part of Novo Seeds’ company creation efforts, where the Novo team and its entrepreneurs-in-residence help build new biotech companies based on groundbreaking new science. Muna joined forces with K5 Therapeutics, co-founded in 2020 by Professor Bart De Strooper from VIB-KU Leuven, Belgium, a pioneer in neurodegenerative diseases research, with investors Droia Ventures and VIB. The combined company - Muna Therapeutics - will be based in Copenhagen and Leuven and is led by seasoned pharma executives CEO Rita Balice-Gordon and COO Anders Hinsby, both entrepreneurs-in-residence of Novo Seeds. Neurodegenerative diseases affect millions of individuals, with increasing global impact as the population ages. Palliative treatments are scarce, and no curative therapies are currently available. Muna is focused on addressing the staggering unmet need experienced by patients around the world with neurodegenerative disorders.

name: Myricx Bio
description: Myricx Bio formerly Myricx Pharma is a drug discovery company focused on developing small molecule inhibitors that selectively target the human N-myristoyltransferases (NMT) in cancer. The company received an initial £4.5 million in seed financing from Sofinnova Partners and Brandon Capital Partners.

name: NanoPhoria
description: NanoPhoria is a biotech company based in Milan that is developing a versatile, non-viral drug delivery platform based on inorganic nanoparticles. The company's first product is a pre-clinical stage treatment for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), a chronic syndrome affecting the lives of millions worldwide. The company, whose four founders have active roles and complimentary backgrounds, is a spin-off from CNR, the largest public research institution in Italy.

name: nChroma (formerly Chroma Medicine)
description: Sofinnova Partners created Epsilen Bio, a biotechnology company developing transformative therapies for patients affected by underserved medical conditions, through stable and long-lasting epigenetic silencing of genes involved in pathological processes. Chroma Medicine acquired the company in November, 2021. Based in Milan, Epsilen Bio was founded in December 2019 by the renowned gene therapy experts Prof. Angelo Lombardo and Prof. Luigi Naldini, The Telethon Foundation and San Raffaele Hospital. Epsilen Bio was a spin-off of SR-Tiget, a world leading cell and gene therapy research institute, and received seed funding from Sofinnova Partners.

name: Nephris
description: Nephris is a pre-clinical biotech company developing first-in-class therapies for chronic kidney diseases. Based in Milan, Italy, the company was founded by Paolo Fiorina, full professor of Endocrinology at the University of Milan and world-renowned authority in the domain, and Dr. Francesca D’Addio. The company was established through a €3 million seed financing from Sofinnova Telethon Fund.

name: Neurent Medical
description: Neurent Medical is dedicated to transforming the treatment landscape for chronic inflammatory sinonasal diseases. Its flagship NEUROMARK System utilizes proprietary Impedance Controlled Radiofrequency technology to gently disrupt hyperactive posterior nasal nerves, delivering durable symptom relief from chronic rhinitis with minimal downtime and a strong safety profile.

name: Nitrase Therapeutics
description: Nitrase Therapeutics is a pioneering biopharmaceutical company deploying its unique NITROME platform to unlock the therapeutic potential of nitrases, a new class of enzymes that it discovered, to develop a pipeline of therapies against a broad variety of diseases. The medicines that Nitrase Therapeutics is developing will target these enzymes and potentially help slow or halt the progression of a wide variety of diseases in which nitrases and nitro-substrates play a role, including Parkinson’s and cancer. Nitrase Therapeutics (under the former name Nitrome Biosciences) has been widely recognized and has won multiple awards including the prestigious Target Advancement grant from The Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson's Research (MJFF).

name: Noema Pharma
description: Noema is a Swiss-based company targeting orphan neurological disorders characterized by imbalanced neuronal networks. The company is developing four mid-clinical-stage therapeutic products in-licensed from Roche and with strong safety packages.

name: Novameat
description: Novameat leads the way in creating sustainable plant-based meats with a unique fibrous texture. Their team of innovators combines advanced food science with culinary expertise to develop a proprietary texture-building technology, scaling the principles of 3D printing at industrial level. By prioritizing nourishing, high-quality ingredients and avoiding common allergens and complex additives, Novameat provides an inclusive protein source.

name: Novexel
description: Novexel was acquired by AstraZeneca in 2010 for more than $500 million. Novexel was an emerging specialty pharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of novel antibiotics designed to overcome the significant global problem of microbial resistance. The ever-increasing resistance to marketed antibiotics has led to a clear need for novel anti-infective agents that are active against multi-drug resistant bacteria.

name: Noxxon Pharma
description: Noxxon Pharma AG is a Biopharma company pioneering the development of a new class of proprietary therapeutics called Spiegelmers, the chemically synthesized, non-immunogenic alternative to antibodies. NOXXON has a diversified portfolio of clinical stage Spiegelmer therapeutics:anti-CCL2/MCP-1 Spiegelmer® NOX-E36 for diabetic nephropathy / anti-CXCL12/SDF-1 Spiegelmer® NOX-A12 for oncology / anti-hepcidin Spiegelmer® NOX-H94 for anemia of chronic disease. The Spiegelmer platform provides the company with powerful and unique discovery capabilities, which have generated a number of additional leads under preclinical investigation.

name: Nuage Therapeutics
description: Nuage Therapeutics is a spin-off from the IRB Barcelona and ICREA. Based at the Barcelona Science Park, Nuage develops drug screening assays to target intrinsically disordered proteins that undergo biomolecular condensation, providing new treatments for diseases currently considered difficult to treat. Part of the technology developed by Nuage Therapeutics was funded by the Asociación Española contra el Cáncer (AECC), through its “AECC Innova” programme, and by ”la Caixa” Foundation, through its CaixaResearch Validate programme.

name: NuCana
description: NuCana [NCNA] is an oncology focused Biopharma company dedicated to the development and commercialization of new medicines to treat patients with cancer. The ProTide Technology Platform has the potential to transform chemotherapy to targeted therapy. ProTides have been designed to target specific patient populations for whom existing chemotherapy is not likely to be effective. By overcoming the key resistance pathways, ProTides aim to significantly improve the efficacy, broaden the clinical utility, and improve the safety profile of many established anticancer agents.

name: ObsEva
description: ObsEva [NASDAQ: OBSV; SIX: OBSN] is a Swiss-based, specialty biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the development of innovative drugs for women’s reproductive medicine. ObsEva’s main focus is on therapies for preterm labor. ObsEva was founded in 2012 by Ernest Loumaye MD, PhD and André Chollet PhD. Ernest Loumaye is a clinician specialized in female reproductive medicine with 20 years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry. He was previously Co-Founder and CEO of PregLem. André Chollet is a medicinal and pharmaceutical chemist with over 30 years of experience gained in diverse roles within the biopharmaceutical industry, including at Biogen, GSK and Merck Serono.

name: Omthera Pharmaceuticals
description: Omthera Pharmaceuticals, an emerging specialty pharmaceuticals company focusing on the clinical development of new therapies for dyslipidemia, was purchased by AstraZeneca in 2013.

name: P2 Science
description: P2 Science is a green chemistry company, co-founded by Professor Paul Anastas and Dr. Patrick Foley at the Center for Green Chemistry and Green Engineering at Yale, that designs and manufactures renewable specialty ingredients for the personal care, flavor & fragrance, and performance materials markets. Using the 12 Principles of Green Chemistry as its foundation, P2 develops proprietary chemical processes and products inspired by nature’s chemistry to deliver high performance with sustainability at scale.

name: Pi-Cardia
description: Pi-Cardia is a global leader in the development of non-implant catheter-based solutions for treating heart valve calcification. Pi-Cardia’s Leaflex™ catheter performs mechanical scoring of valve calcification, restoring leaflets’ mobility and improving valve hemodynamics. The Leaflex™ catheter is designed to be a cost-effective, durable standalone treatment. It can be used for patients who are not planning to undergo a transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) and it can be a means to defer TAVR in patients who may be too young for the procedure. It can also be a preparatory step for improving the outcome of TAVR in heavily-calcified and bicuspid aortic valves.

name: PinCell
description: PinCell is a biotechnology company targeting a novel pathological pathway to develop first-in-class anti-inflammatory therapy for the treatment of rare, severe skin diseases with high unmet medical need. Based in Milan, PinCell was founded in October 2008 as an academic spin-off of the University of Modena and Reggio Emilia by the world-class dermatology experts Prof. Carlo Pincelli and Dr. Alessandra Marconi. PinCell received seed funding from Sofinnova Partners.

name: Pixium Vision
description: Pixium Vision [ALPIX] is developing retinal implant systems for patients who have lost their sight, with the intention of improving their vision and enabling them to lead more independent lives. The Company intends to harness the rapid advances being made in neural processing, micro-electronics and computing to develop retinal implant systems that for blind people could ultimately provide vision approaching that of a normal healthy eye. Pixium’s first device, IRIS1 (Intelligent Retinal Implantable System), uses an epi-retinal implant (on the retinal surface) and is currently in clinical trials with the goal of obtaining CE Mark. A second generation system (IRIS2) based on the same format, but offering better visual acuity and featuring several breakthrough technologies, is also under development. In addition, Pixium is developing a sub-retinal implant system (IRIS3), based on further technological breakthroughs, which has the potential to improve vision significantly compared to IRIS1 and IRIS2. Pixium was created in Paris, France in November 2011 as a spin-out of the Vision Institute and Université Pierre et Marie Curie.

name: preCARDIA
description: preCARDIA developed an inpatient partially implantable device for treating patients with Acute Decompensated Heart Failure (ADHF). It is based on the invention of Dr. Navin Kapur, Interventional Cardiologist and Advanced Heart Failure/Cardiac Transplant specialist, and Director of the Acute Circulatory Support Program at Tufts Medical Center and Dr. Richard Karas, M.D., Ph.D former CSO and former Executive Director Molecular Cardiology Research Institute (MCRI) Tufts Medical Center. The company was acquired by Abiomed in 2021.

name: PregLem
description: PregLem, acquired by the Richter Group in 2010 for 445 million Swiss Francs, is a Swiss-based specialty Biopharma company dedicated to the development and commercialization of innovative drugs for women’s reproductive medicine. PregLem’s activities focus on developing therapies for gynecologic conditions with significant unmet needs and that have a severe impact on the patient’s quality of life: uterine fibroids, endometriosis, infertility through ovarian reserve modulation, and post-surgical adhesions.

name: Prometheus Materials
description: Prometheus Materials delivers sustainable building materials that accelerate the world’s transition to a carbon-negative future. Inspired by biological processes found in nature, the company has developed a technology that uses naturally occurring microalgae to produce a bio-cement that offers an affordable, strong, and durable alternative to carbon-intensive portland cement. When mixed with aggregate, this bio-cement creates a zero-carbon building material with the mechanical, physical, and thermal properties comparable or, in some cases, superior to portland cement-based concrete.

name: ProQR Therapeutics
description: ProQR Therapeutics [PRQR], based in Leiden, is a biotechnology company dedicated to changing lives by developing RNA therapies for rare genetic diseases. The company focuses drug development mainly on a group of blinding disorders affecting the retina, called inherited retinal diseases.

name: Protera
description: Protera is advancing the science of protein engineering to address some of the most critical problems and opportunities in food, agriculture, the environment and human health. We streamline protein design and development with MADI™, our proprietary deep learning algorithm, to predict high value protein products and enzymes with unprecedented speed.

name: Purespring
description: Purespring is the first company to successfully treat kidney disease by targeting the podocyte, a specialized cell that is implicated in the majority of renal disease. It is developing gene therapies to halt or prevent kidney disease, one of humankind’s most poorly treated disease areas. Their platform approach enables streamlined gene therapy development for both monogenic and non-monogenic renal diseases, offering the potential to halt, reverse and even cure both rare and common kidney diseases.

name: Pyrowave
description: Pyrowave is a pioneer in the electrification of chemical processes based on low carbon footprint microwaves. Pyrowave is a leader in the plastics circular economy and chemical recycling. Its unique technology regenerates post-consumer and post-industrial plastics into new plastics, reclaiming these resources’ full value.

name: Qorium
description: Qorium is the world’s leading cell-cultured leather company, having successfully produced a pioneering proof of concept product in 2021. Qorium’s leather comes with dramatically reduced carbon emissions, no methane emissions and radically reduced water and chemical use compared to traditional leather, with no ties to the livestock industry or the polluting processes necessary in the processing of animal hides.

name: Quince Therapeutics (formerly EryDel)
description: Quince Therapeutics, Inc. is a late-stage biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking the power of a patient’s own biology for the treatment of rare diseases. Their Phase 3 lead asset, eDSP, for the treatment of the rare pediatric neurodegenerative disease Ataxia-Telangiectasia (A-T) is the first product in development that leverages their proprietary Autologous Intracellular Drug Encapsulation, or AIDE, technology platform, which is a novel drug/device combination that uses an automated process designed to encapsulate dexamethasone sodium phosphate into the patient’s own red blood cells.

name: ReCor Medical
description: ReCor Medical has developed a unique therapeutic non-focused ultrasound system for performing renal denervation in patients with resistant hypertension. The PARADISE™ technology (Percutaneous Renal Denervation System) includes a 6 French-compatible catheter with a cylindrical transducer that emits ultrasound energy circumferentially, allowing for a more efficient renal denervation procedure.

name: Redona Therapeutics
description: Redona Therapeutics (formerly Twentyeight-Seven Therapeutics) is a biotechnology company focused on the modulation of RNA to treat cancer and other human diseases. Targeting RNA modulating proteins (RMPs), the company can use small molecules to control the expression levels of oncogenes and other proteins of significance. The company’s core technology comes from its four founding scientists, all leading researchers in RNA biology and cancer.

name: Redx Pharma
description: Redx is a UK biotechnology Group whose shares are traded on AIM [AIM:REDX]. Redx is focused on creating and developing first-in-class, or potentially best-in-class drugs, in specific areas of cancer and fibrosis that address significant unmet medical need. Redx has an in-house discovery team with proven world-class chemistry capabilities.

name: RefleXion Medical
description: RefleXion Medical is a privately held medical device company developing the first biologically-guided radiation therapy system for cancer treatment. By leveraging Positron Emission Tomography (PET) in a novel way, RefleXion’s patented technology will allow tumors to continuously signal their location during treatment and potentially revolutionize the practice of radiation oncology. Early validation of RefleXion’s technology was funded by the National Cancer Institute at the National Institutes of Health, part of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (1R43CA153466-1A1).

name: Rezera (formerly NodThera)
description: Rezera is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a portfolio of internally-invented and wholly-owned oral inhibitors of NLRP3 to address inflammatory drivers of cardiovascular and neurologic diseases driven by the NLRP3 inflammation pathway. Rezera is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, with an R&D base in Cambridge, UK.

name: SafeHeal
description: SafeHeal is a leading innovator in the field of digestive surgery. Its CE-marked Colovac device is a unique endoluminal bypass sheath placed in the colon following colorectal resection. It suppresses the contact of fecal content with the colorectal anastomotic site in order to significantly improve patient recovery after colorectal surgery, without the need for an ostomy. It is seamless, minimally invasive and fully reversible. It can remain in place until the body’s natural healing and tissue repair processes are complete.

name: Sensorion
description: Sensorion [ALSEN] is a biopharmaceutical company, formed in 2009, focused as a “pure player” on developing therapies for debilitating inner ear disorders. Sensorion’s mission is to offer innovative therapeutic solutions providing long-term improvements to people living with, or at risk of, inner ear disorders. Sensorion’s portfolio of solutions to unmet medical and social needs in inner ear disorders rests on three pillars – Restore, Treat, Prevent.

name: Shockwave Medical
description: Shockwave Medical [SWAV] created a highly innovative technology focused on solving the problem of heavily calcified arteries, for patients with Peripheral and Coronary Artery Disease (PAD and CAD). The therapy also has promising applications in aortic valve stenosis.

name: Signadori Bio
description: Signadori Bio is a preclinical stage biopharmaceutical company developing an innovative cell therapy approach to treat cancer. The proprietary platform developed by Signadori comes from Institut Gustave Roussy a world leading oncology center. Signadori is based in Paris, France.

name: Sitryx Therapeutics
description: Sitryx Therapeutics Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company focused on regulating cell metabolism to develop disease-modifying therapeutics in immuno-oncology and immuno-inflammation. The field of immunometabolism is a rapidly emerging and exciting area and offers new insights into the role of intracellular metabolism in regulation of the immune response. The energetic status of cells has been shown to be pivotal in controlling the behavior of disease-associated cells in immuno-oncology and immuno-inflammation. Correcting immune cell function and/or inhibiting tumor cell growth through targeting metabolic pathways has the potential to deliver new complementary and highly differentiated approaches to treat a wide range of severe diseases.

name: T-Therapeutics
description: T-Therapeutics is a next-generation T cell receptor (TCR) company spun off from the University of Cambridge. The company was created to harness the power of T cell biology, evolved over millions of years, to create safe and effective treatments for many cancers and autoimmune diseases.

name: Tenpoint Therapeutics
description: Tenpoint is a biotechnology company committed to advancing engineered cell-based therapies and in vivo reprogramming to restore vision for people with degenerative ocular diseases. The company is addressing the ultimate cause of vision loss by replacing diseased cells with healthy ones to permanently restore vision.

name: Tissium
description: Tissium (formerly Gecko Biomedical) is a privately owned medical device company based in Paris that is dedicated to the rapid development and commercialization of a unique biopolymers platform. Tissium’s first product (GB-02) is an innovative polymer for tissue healing, targeting cardiovascular reconstruction as an initial indication. The structure of GB-02 is tunable, allowing customization for various applications and tissues. Gecko’s biopolymers platform is fully industrialized and highly versatile, with potential novel applications in other fields of tissue reconstruction, such as guided tissue repair and localized drug delivery. Tissium’s platform is based on proprietary biopolymers with unique chemical and physical properties, including high viscosity, hydrophobicity and fast “on demand” curing for precise local delivery and in situ adhesion.

name: Tulyp Medical
description: Tulyp Medical is a Paris-based privately held, medical device company and part of Sofinnova MD Start, Sofinnova Partners' medical device accelerator. The company is developing a patented pressure-driven perfusion system for vascular procedures. Based on the fundamental principle that oxygen delivery is governed by vascular pressure rather than flow, Tulyp’s technology is designed to improve tissue oxygenation and reduce complications in patients undergoing major interventions.

name: VectivBio
description: Comet Therapeutics (formerly TM3) was founded in April 2017 in The Netherlands. The company focused on the treatment of orphan neurological disorders through Coenzyme-A substitution therapy strategies. In 2021, VectivBio Holding AG (VECT), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering novel transformational treatments for severe rare conditions, acquired Comet Therapeutics, significantly expanding VectivBio’s rare disease pipeline.

name: Verley (formerly Bon Vivant)
description: Bon Vivant is a biotechnology company based in Lyon, France, that uses precision fermentation to produce milk proteins. These milk proteins are then used by food manufacturers to produce dairy products with identical nutritional characteristics, taste and texture to conventional dairy products, but with much less environmental impact.

name: Verona Pharma
description: Verona Pharma plc [VRNA] is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of innovative prescription medicines to treat respiratory diseases with significant unmet medical needs, such as COPD, cystic fibrosis and asthma.

description: Nextmesh on mobiiliystävällinen markkinointialusta, joka on integroitu Wi-Fi-verkkoihin. Nextmesh auttaa löytämään oikeat tuotemerkit alustalle, jolloin verkon omistajat voivat ansaita rahaa Wi-Fi-investoinneistaan.

description: ReFaMo tuo mittauksiin ja tietoon perustuvan lähestymistavan hitsattujen teräsrakenteiden mitoitukseen ja elinkaaren hallintaan ReFaMon ratkaisu perustuu hitsattujen teräsrakenteiden väsymisen mittaukseen ja analysointiin käyttökohteessa sensoreilla edge computing -pohjaisesti.

name: Chemical.AI
description: Chemical.AI 成立于 2018 年，是一家致力于利用人工智能与专家规则推进化学逆合成与分子合成的创新企业。 其旗舰平台 ChemAIRS® 不仅在逆合成分析（retrosynthesis）中具备强劲能力，还提供合成可行性评估、工艺化学（process chemistry）、杂质预测及正向合成（forward synthesis）等功能。 Chemical.AI 服务于制药公司、生物技术公司和合同研究组织（CROs），目标是降低新药研究与合成路线设计的复杂性与成本，加快新分子从设计到实验验证的周期。

name: Dimension5
description: 南京维伍网络科技有限公司（Dimension5）成立于2015年，专注于 3D实时渲染技术，核心产品 D5渲染器（D5 Render） 基于 Unreal Engine 和 NVIDIA RTX 技术，实现 秒级渲染，广泛应用于建筑、室内、景观设计等领域。2019年成为 NVIDIA全球ISV合作伙伴，2020年正式发布后全球下载量超百万，覆盖200+国家。公司获 国家级高新技术企业 认证，拥有 30+项知识产权。2023年推出 AI空间设计工具D5 Hi，持续推动3D创作智能化。

name: Keeway
description: Keeway是钱江摩托旗下的国际品牌，专注于摩托车、踏板车及相关产品的研发、制造与销售。

name: Liblib
description: LiblibAl·哩布哩布Al是中国领先原创AI模型分享社区，成立于2023年5月，专注于原创AI模型与素材创作，已积累近1000万创作者，生成超2.3亿张图片致力于AI内容的创作和分享。

name: Meshy
description: Meshy 是全球最直观的 AI 3D 模型生成工具，让用户仅需输入文字提示或上传图像，即可在数秒内生成可用于生产的 3D 资产——无需任何专业建模技能。Meshy 能显著提升游戏开发、动画、电影制作、3D 打印、VR/AR、产品设计等多场景的内容生产效率，帮助团队降低成本、加速规模化创作，并释放更大的创新潜力。

name: Moody
description: Moody是一家专注于彩色隐形眼镜（美瞳）产品的新兴品牌，凭借高颜值设计和优质佩戴体验迅速占领年轻人市场，推动了国内彩瞳消费的潮流化趋势。

name: OPay
description: OPay 是尼日利亚的金融科技／移动支付平台，成立于 2013 年（最初为 Paycom Nigeria），2018 年获得中央银行许可。服务包括转账、电子支付、账单支付、充值、借记卡/钱包等，目标是通过科技降低用户财务门槛，普惠金融为更多人提供安全、便捷、负担得起的金融服务。

name: PMPM
description: PMPM是国产护肤品牌，主打“全球寻香之旅”的概念，融合不同地域的植物成分与香气文化，推出具有国际质感的本土护肤产品，强调成分安全与感官体验的双重满足。

name: Sand.ai
description: Sand AI是一家深耕人工智能领域的创业公司，专注于视频生成。

name: Stori
description: Stori 是一家拉美金融科技公司，目标是为被传统银行系统覆盖不足的人群提供信用卡及存款服务。截至目前已有超过 300 万用户，产品包括信用卡、存款账户等，强调审核宽松、用户易用性和低门槛准入。

name: TBDx
description: TBDx 是一家体验设计公司。我们通过真正融合突破性技术、创新商业模式与以人为本的设计，致力于让那些优质却曾专属少数人的生活体验走向大众。

name: usmile
description: Usmile是广州星际悦动股份有限公司旗下的专业口腔护理品牌，创立于2015年，创始人陈建群。品牌致力于将科技美学与使用功效融合于全线口腔护理产品上，以提升全民口腔健康为使命。其代表性产品包括智能电动牙刷Y30等，强调“预防大于治疗”的理念，并倡导像护肤一样护理口腔。

name: Wonderlab
description: Wonderlab是一个专注于健康营养食品的品牌，提供代餐奶昔、益生菌等产品，倡导健康生活方式。

name: 一亩田
description: 北京一亩田新农网络科技有限公司（Yimutian Inc.），成立于 2011 年，总部位于北京海淀区，是中国领先的农业产业互联网企业。公司以“让每一亩田更有价值”为使命，通过移动互联网与数字技术搭建农产品产销 B2B 平台，为农产品生产者、批发商、商超、餐饮等买家提供从信息匹配、交易撮合到结算的全链路服务。平台包括 “一亩田 App”、“豆牛智慧代卖服务”、数字规模化种植基地等多个业务板块，覆盖农资、农机、瓜果蔬菜、禽畜肉蛋、坚果干果等品类。截止至最近，公司已聚集数千万 B 端用户，商品品类丰富，同时依托 AI、大数据等技术提升交易效率和供应链透明度

name: 东恒新能源
description: 无锡东恒新能源成立于2011年，由纺织企业转型而来，专注纳米材料及锂电导电浆料研发。其碳纳米管导电浆料已供应比亚迪、三星等头部电池厂商，性能达国际领先水平。公司依托复旦大学产学研合作，拥有28人研发团队，70%具锂电或纳米材料研发背景。现为国内最大动力电池用碳纳米导电材料供应商，并获江苏省高新技术企业认证

name: 东方鸿鹄
description: 东方鸿鹄融合了互联网领先者字节跳动的线上数字能力，与饮料龙头企业王老吉的线下渠道能力，致力于数字化的方式重构线下全链路交易场景。公司已经沉淀了完善的产品设计能力，形成了有效科学的产品研发方法论，高效助力未来新品类扩张，并成功打造数字化营销底层能力平台，通过数字化能力革新传统线下渠道，实现了品牌、消费者、经销商、终端销售渠道的数字换闭环，真正做到了全链路的可视可控。

name: 中海储能
description: 中海储能科技（北京）有限公司（简称中海储能）是一家为新能源建设提供储能解决方案的科技型企业，专注于新型大容量电化学储能产品——铁铬液流电池储能系统的研究开发，集研发、生产、制造与商业化应用为一体，是国内铁铬液流电池技术的先行者和集大成者。

name: 乐动机器人
description: 2017年成立的国家高新技术企业，专注于机器人移动感知技术自主研发和生产制造，拥有300+项知识产权，覆盖环境感知、自主导航及AI算法。产品应用于清洁、商用服务机器人领域，服务全球上百家企业，获中国高价值专利奖及深圳高层次人才计划支持。

name: 云鲸智能
description: 云鲸创立于2016年，是一家立足家用机器人领域、致力于研发革命性科技产品的公司。作为一家机器人创新企业，云鲸横跨了SLAM、三维感知、AI物体识别、机器人结构技术、大数据应用等多个领域，目前已在多个方向取得突破，已累计申请了超1100篇技术专利。2019年双十一，云鲸凭借独创的“拖布自清洁”功能引爆消费市场.2023年，云鲸开启多领域布局，进军智能洗地机领域。2024年，云鲸多品齐发，完成多价格段布局，并加速拓展线下渠道，门店分布成都、重庆、武汉、广州、苏州等多个城市。

name: 众能联合
description: 众能联合数字技术有限公司成立于2016年，总部位于南京，是一家专注于工程机械设备租赁及数字化管理服务的企业。公司通过平台化运营模式，为客户提供高空作业设备、挖掘机械等多种工程设备的灵活租赁服务，提升行业效率与服务质量。

name: 健海科技
description: 健海科技是一家专注于智慧医疗与健康管理的科技企业，成立于2015年，总部位于杭州。公司以“让健康管理更智能”为核心理念，提供基于AI的慢病管理平台、患者随访系统、智能问诊工具等解决方案，助力医疗机构实现数字化转型。

name: 元保
description: 元保数科是一家专注于保险科技与数字健康服务的企业，成立于2018年，总部位于北京。公司通过大数据、AI等技术手段优化保险产品设计与风险控制，同时整合健康管理资源，为用户提供个性化保险+健康服务方案。

name: 兰
description: LAN（兰）是中国纯净功效护肤品牌，2012年由丁小兰创立，所属公司为杭州兰禧化妆品有限公司，总部位于浙江省杭州市。 品牌以“生命如蘭 美丽如常”为口号，坚持“精净、高能”的纯净护肤定位，首倡Clean Beauty理念，主打“以油养肤”产品线，代表性产品包括水感卸妆油、臻米糯感洁颜油等。

name: 凌空天行
description: 凌空天行是国内从事高超音速飞行技术与应用服务的商业航天企业，具有全系统覆盖的高超音速飞行器总体设计能力。

name: 剂泰医药
description: 剂泰医药成立于2019年，总部位于深圳，是以人工智能（AI）驱动、利用精准靶向的药物递送和药物发现技术，为患者开发更有效的治疗药物的创新型生物技术公司。

name: 加速进化
description: 加速进化成立于 2023 年，是一家聚焦具身智能与人形机器人研发的科技公司。创始团队有清华大学机器人、自动化领域背景，产品定位在科研、教育以及未来家庭生活场景。公司致力于自主设计机器人本体、运控操作系统、开发者工具（SDK）等软硬件平台。

name: 卧安机器人
description: 卧安机器人（SwitchBot）隶属于卧安机器人（深圳）股份有限公司，是全球领先的AI具身家庭机器人系统提供商，致力于构建以智能家庭机器人为核心的智能家庭生态系统。公司以机器人定位与环境构建技术、AI机器视觉控制技术、分布式神经控制网络技术三大核心技术为底座，以智慧家庭全场景覆盖的产品矩阵为载体，持续推动AI具身智能技术在家庭场景的应用落地。

name: 厨芯智能
description: 厨芯科技，致力于成为全球领先的餐饮设备和服务提供商。从商厨清洁领域着手，提供餐饮后厨“一站式服务”解决方案，驱动餐饮行业的智能化和数字化升级。厨芯业务范围现已覆盖全国超200座城市。通过部署在客户现场的自研物联网设备，结合云端数据调控，智能服务调度，帮助餐厅高效快速实现餐具清洁及菜品出品，并以自建运营网络提供全方位优质服务，帮助餐厅降本增效，全面守护餐饮卫生安全。

name: 和生创新
description: 深圳和生创新（2020年成立）专注智能家电研发与销售，主打欧美线上市场。公司以用户需求驱动产品设计，结合物联网技术优化生活场景，主张以科技赋能家电产品，与全球家庭共享科技和创新的乐趣。

name: 塔斯汀
description: 塔斯汀品牌隶属于福州塔斯汀餐饮管理有限公司，是一个主营中国汉堡的餐饮连锁品牌，面向具备个性主张、独特审美、独立意识的年轻受众群体，全力打造符合国人口味的手擀现烤中国汉堡。

name: 壁仞科技
description: 壁仞科技研发高性能通用GPU，打造自主原创的高性能GPU软硬件体系，构建国产智能计算产业生态。首代壁仞科技通用GPU产品基于原创训推一体芯片架构，已在多地智算中心落地，壁仞科技实现中国首个四种及以上异构芯片混训技术落地，突破了算力孤岛难题。

name: 壹米滴答
description: 壹米滴答成立于 2015 年，是中国一家综合型物流 / 供应链服务公司，主营 B2B 零担运输 & 仓配业务，覆盖全国省、市、县/区网络。“滴答到门”、大票零担、小票快运、整车等多种物流产品。公司重视数据化 / AI /云计算/物联网等技术在物流网络规划与运输效率提升的应用。

name: 奇点能源
description: 奇点能源是一家专注于先进储能系统中核心装备技术研究和产品开发，致力于推动大规模清洁能源接入，为全球碳中和目标贡献解决方案的公司。

name: 奕信通
description: 北京奕信通科技有限公司，是一家技术领先的ICT液冷产品与解决方案提供商，集产研一体化、解决方案提供、液冷全寿命周期服务于一身的高科技制造企业。公司成立于2021年，总部位于北京，2023年获数千万人民币的A轮融资。公司自研冷板液冷和浸没液冷双技术路线，目前累计交付200MW液冷案例，项目遍布国内外，

name: 奕斯伟材料
description: 从事硅材料业务的奕斯伟材料公司是一家12英寸电子级硅单晶抛光片和外延片的提供商，产品广泛应用于电子通讯、新能源汽车等领域所需要的存储芯片、逻辑芯片、图像传感器、显示驱动芯片及功率器件等。

name: 孔辉科技
description: 国内首家实现乘用车空气悬架系统量产供货的企业，由中国工程院郭孔辉院士团队创立，总部位于湖州，拥有重庆、广州、武汉制造基地及苏州研发总院。核心产品包括电控悬架系统、空气弹簧总成等，获岚图、理想、比亚迪等16家车企40余车型定点，拥有百余项专利，获国家专精特新“小巨人”认证。

name: 字节跳动
description: 字节跳动以人工智能为核心技术驱动产品发展，成立于2012年3月，是最早将人工智能应用于移动互联网场景的科技企业之一。公司以建设"全球创作与交流平台"为愿景 。字节跳动的全球化布局始于2015年 ，"技术出海"是字节跳动全球化发展的核心战略 ，其旗下产品有今日头条、西瓜视频、抖音、皮皮虾、懂车帝、悟空问答等。

name: 宇树科技
description: 是国内研发、生产和销售消费级、行业级高性能四足机器人、灵巧六轴机械臂的新锐创企，也是全球最早一批实现四足机器人商业化的公司之一。被广泛应用在农业、工业领域，以及特定的安防巡检、勘测探索、公共救援、医疗防疫陪护等重磅行业中提供强有力支持。

name: 安世亚太
description: 安世亚太科技股份有限公司成立于2003年，是中国工业企业研发信息化领域的领先者，专注于PLM（产品生命周期管理）、虚拟仿真等技术领域，推动中国工业技术创新与发展。

name: 安仕新能源
description: 安仕新能源，深耕锂电产品，专注于锂离子和磷酸铁锂电池组的研发，在锂电池领域处于领军地位，特别是192V 磷酸铁锂高压UPS电池组领域，行业市场占有率处于第一位置。安仕新能源也上榜2020年深圳市第一批高新认定名单。

name: 小红岛
description: 小红岛（隶属于南京众岛电子商务有限公司），成立于 2019 年 9 月，是一家社区新零售服务商，主要面向年轻家庭，尤其是社区场景中对便利性与性价比有较高需求的消费群体。小红岛以“成本价运营”的模式为会员提供全天候折扣商品，整体价格约为市场零售价的 6-7 折；支持“1 小时送货上门”“门店自提”及“到店选购”等多种购物方式，且门槛低，多数南京地区门店通用。

name: 布鲁可
description: 布鲁可是中国积木原创品牌，隶属于布鲁可集团，致力于传递“拼的快乐”，拥有500多项专利，是国家知识产权优势企业。其产品线涵盖大颗粒积木、主题系列及教育类积木玩具，深受儿童喜爱。

name: 微脉
description: 微脉是一家数字健康公司，成立于2015年9月9日，首创AI+全病程管理，推动医疗健康服务的数智化升级，赋能医疗机构和医护人员，为全人群提供全方位、全周期的医疗健康服务，满足老百姓多层次、多样化、个性化的服务需求。

name: 德兰明海
description: 深圳市德兰明海新能源股份有限公司，成立于2013年，专注于用户侧储能产品和分布式储能解决方案，掌握国际先进的新能源储能技术及完整储能电池应用方案，在光伏储能一体化、离并网微电网系统等领域具有领先优势。

name: 恩和生物
description: Bota Bio（恩和生物）是一家合成生物学领域的创新企业，专注于通过人工智能驱动的生物工程平台进行新型蛋白质设计和生物制造，广泛应用于医药、食品、农业等领域。公司成立于2019年，总部位于杭州，并设有美国分部。

name: 悦刻
description: 悦刻是中国电子烟行业的领先品牌，由汪莹创立于2018年，专注于研发、生产和销售高品质电子烟产品。悦刻以其时尚设计、丰富口味和良好的用户体验迅速占领市场，成为国内电子烟消费市场的头部品牌之一。公司于2021年在美国纽交所上市（股票代码：RLX）。

name: 扬腾集团
description: 福建扬腾创新信息科技有限公司，始于2013年，总部位于福建省福州市，在深圳、德国汉堡、美国加州、香港等地设有全资子公司，是一家集设计、研发、销售为一体的综合型汽车零配件运营企业。

name: 擎朗智能
description: 擎朗智能科技是一家专注于室内无人配送机器人研发与应用的高科技企业，总部位于上海。公司核心产品为“擎朗送餐机器人”，广泛应用于餐厅、酒店、医院等场景，提供高效、稳定的智能服务解决方案。其代表产品如Geli系列机器人已实现大规模商业化落地，在行业内具有领先地位。

name: 斯坦德机器人
description: 斯坦德机器人是全球领先的工业智能移动机器人解决方案提供商和提供工业具身智能机器人解决方案的先驱。

name: 新潮传媒
description: 新潮传媒是中国社区媒体数字化平台的代表企业之一，专注于电梯媒体和社区场景广告投放，利用AI和大数据技术实现精准触达，服务于本地生活、快消、教育等多个行业客户，推动传统户外媒体向数字化转型。

name: 明灏科技
description: 明灏科技(北京)有限公司是一家以自主研发为核心，专注于先进医学视光技术开发和成果转化、医学视光产品精密制造和视光医疗信息化的国家级高新技术企业和专精特新企业。

name: 易久批
description: 易久批平台由易久批信息技术有限公司运营管理。易久批信息技术有限公司及其持股、控股企业从创立到现在走过了7个年头，已发展成为跨品类、跨区域、全产业链的快销品产业互联网企业集团，是中国新一代的互联网独角兽企业、国内领先的产业互联网平台。

name: 易点云
description: 易点云成立于2014年，是中国领先的IT办公设备租赁服务提供商，专注于为企业客户提供一站式IT设备全生命周期管理解决方案，涵盖电脑、打印机、服务器等设备的租赁、维护及回收服务。通过SaaS平台实现设备远程管理，助力企业降本增效，提升信息化管理水平。

name: 星猿哲科技
description: 星猿哲科技（XYZ Robotics）成立于 2018 年，总部位于上海，是一家专注于移动复合机器人和 3D 视觉产品研发，赋能全球物流和制造生产力升级。凭借前沿的感知和规划技术，星猿哲提供装卸车、拆码垛、无序抓取、装配等解决方案，覆盖医药、食品、烟酒、电商、汽车、新能源等行业。星猿哲获评国家级专精特新企业，累计完成 1 亿美元融资。

name: 星迈创新
description: 星迈创新（成立于2022年7月）是一家专注于泳池智能清洁机器人研发与创新的科技公司，以户外/泳池场景机器人化为主攻方向，品牌名为 Beatbot。公司拥有自主研发的如无刷水泵、SLAM 导航算法、浮力智能控制系统等核心技术，并在高端泳池机器人产品中占据市场领先地位。截至最新融资周期，公司已完成 A 轮融资，累计融资超过5亿元人民币，估值近20亿元人民币。

name: 星锐医药
description: 星锐医药(Starna Therapeutics) 成立于2021年8月，公司聚焦肝外靶向递送技术，致力于研发以RNA为核心的创新药物，解决未被满足的临床需求。

name: 昱言生物
description: 昱言生物（Foreseen Biotechnology / 昱言科技（北京）有限公司）是一家由蛋白质组学领域专家及具有国际大型药企经验的海归博士团队于 2021 年创立的生物技术创新企业。 公司基于前沿蛋白质组学平台，从临床未被满足的需求出发，设计人群队列，获取高质量、多维度的蛋白组学信息，并结合多组学分析，以加速生物标志物（biomarker）与创新药物靶点的发现。 在诊断方向，公司已启动第一个化学发光 IVD 产品注册，并和医院合作开展 LDT（实验室开发测试）的联合开发；在治疗方向，通过其 ADC 等项目（如 FS001）与国际合作伙伴达成许可或联合开发。 场景涉及肿瘤、炎症／自身免疫、神经系统等多个难治疾病领域。

name: 月之暗面
description: 月之暗面 (Moonshot AI) 创立于2023年3月，致力于寻求将能源转化为智能的最优解，打造全能新质生产力。现已推出支持深度思考、多模态推理、能够输入20万字长文本的智能助手产品 Kimi。

name: 柯泰亚生物
description: 柯泰亚生物是一家致力于通过合成生物技术，研发、生产和销售高附加值生物基产品，为食品营养、个人护理、医药等市场提供天然、绿色、高质量创新原料的合成生物公司。

name: 标果工厂
description: 成都标果科技有限公司（简称：标果工厂）创建于2020年初，创始人和联合创始人曾作为中国最大的干线物流互联网平台货车帮的CEO及天使投资人，深度参与了中国物流行业的升级，让中国干线物流的效率整体提升，该平台2021年在纽交所上市（满帮: US YMM）。经历5年创业，标果工厂成为中国互联网生鲜B2B公司中年规模领先且保持持续盈利能力的商业组织。截至2025年4月，已经在四川、江西、湖南、河南、广东、河北、陕西、浙江、贵州等9省开展业务，业务涉及水果、蔬菜、冻品、奶品等类别，员工超过1300人。

name: 梅卡曼德
description: 梅卡曼德机器人由清华海归团队于2016年创办，致力于推动具身智能机器人无所不在的存在。采用先进AI和传感技术，梅卡曼德打造出强大的机器人3D视觉眼睛、AI大脑及仿生五指灵巧手，具备高通用性、高标准化等特点。能快速适配各种机器人形态，赋予机器人精准感知、智能决策和高效执行的能力。让机器人走入千行百业、千家万户，适应更多复杂场景的多样化需求。

name: 橙氧科技
description: 上海橙氧科技成立于2018年，专注于电化学技术及设备研发，致力于低碳化学品现场生产。其核心产品为分布式双氧水发生系统，解决了传统双氧水生产的高污染、高碳排问题，已获全球纸业巨头采用。2022年完成数千万元A轮融资，由沃衍资本、盈德气体等投资，资金用于电化学碳减排技术研发及市场化拓展。公司还在开发氯碱电解槽、可逆空气电池等新型产品，推动化工行业绿色转型。

name: 橡鹿机器人
description: 橡鹿机器人是橡鹿科技旗下公司，是一家专注于提升餐饮供给质量的硬科技公司。聚焦Robot + Food战略方向，公司⾃主研发智能炒菜机器⼈美膳狮。美膳狮完美复现“⼤师级”厨师的烹饪手法与味道，提供机器人+菜谱程序+后厨智能管理系统的交付闭环模式，帮助餐饮商家实现规模化复制，帮助消费者吃上新鲜、现炒有锅气的食物。美膳狮已在餐饮、酒店、等多个场景运用，落地众多头部餐饮品牌，获得非团餐类智能炒菜机器人出货量第一，成为行业领导者。

name: 欣旺达电池
description: 欣旺达以“创新驱动新能源世界进步”为使命，深耕锂电池领域，致力于为社会提供更多绿色、快速、高效的新能源一体化解决方案。公司构建了3C消费类电池、动力电池、储能系统、智能硬件、创新与生态五大业务。在立足深圳、服务全球的愿景下，目前已在国内的广东、江苏、浙江、山东、江西、四川、湖北等省份，以及印度、越南、匈牙利、摩洛哥等国家布局多个生产制造基地，在美国、法国、德国、以色列、韩国、日本设立海外营销机构。

name: 每日黑巧
description: 每日黑巧是一家主打健康理念的巧克力品牌，以无糖黑巧切入市场，采用可可含量高的配方，倡导低糖、健康的饮食方式，受到注重营养和身材管理人群的喜爱。

name: 法奥机器人
description: 法奥机器人成立于2019年，在全球率先实现供应链创新，是一家全核心零部件自研自产的协作机器人公司。

name: 浙达能源
description: 国内领先的智慧能源、智能电网、电力交易、虚拟电厂、数字孪生技术产品服务提供商和集成运营商。

name: 海柔创新
description: 海柔创新是一家专注箱式仓储机器人系统的科技企业，致力于为全球企业提供高效、智能的仓储自动化解决方案。公司自主研发的库宝系统（HAIPICK）实现了物料搬运与存储的柔性化升级，在电商、制造、零售等多个行业广泛应用。

name: 深势科技
description: 深势科技是全球AI for Science领导者，依托在交叉学科领域的深耕，构建了“深势·宇知”AI for Science大模型体系，并进一步解决科学研究和工业研发领域的关键问题，将众多学科的科研方法从“实验试错 / 计算机”时代带入了“预训练模型时代”，形成了AI for Science的“创新-落地”链路和开放生态，赋能“千行百业”，为人类经济发展最基础的生物医药、能源、材料和信息科学与工程研究打造新一代工业设计与仿真系统。

name: 深度智控
description: 深度智控（南京深度智控科技有限公司）是一家行业领先的深度节能与数智化创新服务商，专注于研发新一代深度节能与物联智控前沿产品与技术，赋能工业与建筑节能行业。

name: 深纳普思
description: 深纳普思是一家专注于AI+医疗健康领域，通过医用级智能可穿戴设备和深度学习算法，为慢性病患者提供智能化、数字化的控病解决方案的公司。

name: 爱科农
description: 爱科农是一家专注于农业大数据、机器学习预测和农业物联网技术，为农业生产者提供智慧种植决策服务的高新技术企业。

name: 特纳飞
description: 特纳飞是一家提供固态硬盘控制器整体解决方案的创业公司，专注于Flash Based高速存储芯片、固件与系统设计开发。

name: 王小卤
description: 王小卤是北京王小卤网络科技有限公司旗下的零食品牌，成立于2016年，总部位于北京。作为虎皮凤爪品类的领军者，王小卤凭借川卤与酱卤技术结合，打造无添加剂卤味产品，主打虎皮凤爪单品连续多年稳居天猫鸡肉零食类目销量第一。

name: 理想汽车
description: 理想汽车成立于2015年，是一家中国新能源汽车制造商，专注于设计、研发、制造和销售豪华智能电动汽车。其首席执行官为创始人李想，总部位于北京，并在江苏常州设有自有生产基地。理想汽车致力于为家庭打造更安全、更便捷、更舒适的智能电动车，主要产品包括理想L9（全尺寸六座SUV）、理想L8（中大型六座SUV）、理想L7（中大型五座SUV）等。公司于纳斯达克（NASDAQ：LI）和港交所（2015）上市。

name: 百布
description: 百布是中国领先的纺织产业互联网平台，成立于2014年，专注于为服装企业提供从面料采购、供应链管理到智能制造的一站式解决方案。公司通过数字化手段重构传统纺织产业链，提升交易效率与生产协同能力。

name: 百果园
description: 百果园（全称深圳百果园实业（集团）股份有限公司），2001年成立于深圳，是一家集水果采购、种植支持、采后保鲜、物流仓储、标准分级、营销拓展、品牌运营、门店零售、信息科技、金融资本、科研教育于一体的大型连锁企业。

name: 矽行半导体
description: 矽行公司成立于2021年11月，由科创板首批上市公司天准科技及其核心管理团队合资创立，总部位于苏州。公司核心团队汇聚了来自国内外知名半导体设备公司、晶圆代工厂、上市公司和研究机构的顶尖人才，专注于高端晶圆缺陷检测设备及零部件的研发、生产和销售。矽行依托卓越的人才团队和合作伙伴，运用最先进的人工智能技术和超高精密的光机电技术，促进半导体制程的工艺改善和良率提升，帮助下游客户实现更高质量、更高效率、更大价值。矽行致力于成为全球领先的半导体光学检测设备公司，持续推动行业的进步。

name: 硅基仿生
description: 深圳硅基仿生科技有限公司是一家致力于医用有源植入和医疗人工智能研发与产业化的公司。公司总部位于深圳。此外，公司在美国洛杉矶、北京和广州设有分部。

name: 祥邦科技
description: 祥邦科技（浙江祥邦科技股份有限公司）是国内封装胶膜领域的领导型企业之一，致力于研发、生产和销售光伏组件用封装胶膜，产品以POE光伏胶膜为主，同时覆盖EPE、白膜、EVA等全系列，并向客户提供定制化胶膜产品。公司目前拥有华中和华东两大生产基地，正在积极筹建海外生产基地以及国内第三处生产基地。

name: 美克生能源
description: 上海美克生能源科技有限公司成立于2018年，是一家面向新型电力系统的分布式绿色能源聚合服务商。在国家“双碳”战略指导下，公司聚焦AI储能调节运营，面向市场提供能源资产的投资建设、安全运维、聚合增值等多元化新型能源科技服务，全面助力千行百业实现绿色低碳转型。

name: 美团
description: 美团（港交所代码：3690.HK）是中国领先的生活服务电子商务平台，提供外卖、到店、酒旅、出行等多种本地生活服务，致力于用科技连接人与服务，提升城市生活的便利性与效率。

name: 联盛新能源
description: 联盛新能源集团，成立于2009年，是中国领先的清洁能源综合服务商，主营业务涵盖光伏发电、风能发电、储能系统集成以及能源互联网解决方案，致力于为企业和政府提供绿色电力支持，推动碳中和目标实现 。公司项目遍布全国多个省市，并积极拓展海外市场。

name: 聚芯微电子
description: 武汉聚芯微电子有限责任公司，成立于2016年，专注于高性能模拟与混合信号集成电路的研发与销售，主要产品包括电源管理芯片、音频功放芯片等，广泛应用于消费电子、工业控制和汽车电子领域。公司已获得多项核心技术专利，并与国内外多家知名企业建立合作关系。

name: 腾希航空科技
description: 腾希航空（厦门腾希航空科技有限公司）是一家专业从事电动垂直起降飞行器（eVTOL）、无人自转旋翼机的研发、生产与服务的高科技企业，致力于成为城市空中交通服务的全球领航者。

name: 自如

description: 英得尔成立于2005年6月，专注研发与生产车载冰箱，是一家行业领先面向全球的专业制造商。首期园区占地面积88亩，建筑面积超10万平方米，拥有行业领先的专业实验室及智能生产线。总部位于广东中山，分别在上海、佛山、香港、英国、美国等国家或地区设立分部，拓展全球业务。公司分为前装定制、零售品牌、ODM三大板块业务。

name: 茶颜悦色
description: 茶颜悦色是中国知名的现制茶饮品牌，起源于湖南长沙，以中国风的品牌设计和特色茶饮产品著称，深受年轻消费者喜爱，是新式茶饮行业的代表性品牌之一。

name: 视涯科技
description: 视涯科技股份有限公司（简称“视涯科技”）创立于2016年10月，是一家专业从事新一代半导体OLEDoS显示器研发、设计、生产和销售的高科技企业。视涯科技致力于打造OLEDoS显示应用生态链，为客户提供端到端微显示相关解决方案。

name: 贝壳找房
description: 贝壳找房是中国领先的房产交易与服务平台，致力于构建“技术驱动的品质居住服务生态”。公司以“科技+服务”为核心，提供新房、二手房、租房等全方位房产信息服务，并通过VR看房、智能找房等技术创新提升用户体验。

name: 赛桥生物
description: 赛桥生物是一家CGT智能制造解决方案提供商，专注于CGT行业上游关键制造技术及成套核心工艺装备的源头技术创新和国产化工作，致力于实现CGT产业化装备的全封闭、自动化、数字化和柔性化。

name: 赛纳生物
description: 赛纳生物科技（北京）有限公司是一家集基因技术研发、成果转化、生产与营销于一体的国家高新技术企业，公司总部位于北京亦庄经济开发区。 成立团队包括谢晓亮院士、黄岩谊教授、陈子天博士等科学家，以荧光发生测序技术和纠错编码测序技术为核心技术，强调从技术源头创新以提升测序准确性和成本效率。 赛纳生物为生命科学研究和基因诊断提供核心测序设备，同时在肿瘤、病原微生物、生殖健康、环境与食品安全等领域推出快速、准确、简便的解决方案。 公司产品与服务涵盖测序仪器、试剂以及分析软件等，是国产化基因测序生态的一部分。

name: 运去哪
description: 上海汇航捷讯网络科技有限公司（运去哪）是国内首家国际物流电商交易平台，总部位于上海。公司致力于为全球货主和货代提供一站式国际物流服务，涵盖在线运价查询、订舱、支付、订单追踪等环节，通过引入电商模式大幅提升行业的透明度与运作效率。运去哪拥有覆盖北美、拉美、东南亚等重点区域的分支机构，链接超过300家船公司与航空公司，整合3500+优质供应商资源，形成强大的生态网络。同时，公司组建了超过500人的专业客服与履约团队，全程保障客户货物运输的安全与顺畅。凭借技术驱动与服务创新，运去哪正推动传统国际物流向数字化、智能化转型，成为连接中国与全球市场的重要桥梁。

name: 锐锢商城

name: 长光辰芯
description: 长光辰芯是全球领先的高性能CMOS图像传感器提供商，总部位于中国长春，同时在中国杭州、大连及比利时安特卫普、日本东京设有子公司，为全球合作伙伴提供先进的CMOS图像传感器产品和优质服务。多年来，长光辰芯一直致力于技术研发和创新，现已掌握全局快门像素、HDR像素、高灵敏度像素、低噪声电路、高速读出电路、TDI图像传感器、BSI图像传感器、3D成像传感器及3D晶圆堆叠等多项核心技术，在高性能CMOS图像传感器的像素设计、电路设计、工艺开发等关键环节，形成了坚实的技术壁垒。公司目前已形成9大系列具备自主知识产权、引领市场发展的CMOS图像传感器产品，在工业成像、科学成像、专业影像和医疗成像等先进技术领域实现广泛应用。

name: 阶梯医疗
description: 上海阶梯医疗科技有限公司（简称：阶梯医疗）成立于2021年8月，总部坐落于上海，是一家专注于植入式脑机接口领域的创新型科技企业。公司以植入式脑机接口技术为立足点，致力于神经界面（电极）的研发、植入式脑机接口平台系统的开发，及相关科研成果的临床应用转化工作，旨在实现运动控制、神经疾病病灶监测及调控、感知觉修复。阶梯医疗还自研并生产神经电生理科研工具产品，为脑科学和神经科学基础研究提供有力的支持。阶梯医疗坚持以“成为人类进步的阶梯”为使命，以“推动人类对脑科学与脑机接口的理解与认知”为发展愿景，力争打造成为世界领先的脑机接口品牌。

name: Afference
description: Afference is a hardware-enabled software company at the forefront of Spatial Computing, which involves the digitization and interaction with real-world spaces through digital devices. It is poised to transform how users interact with digital content. Current input methods, such as hand tracking technologies lack any tactile feedback, which is crucial for sensory perception involving vision, sound, and touch. Afference addresses this gap with their innovative haptic device, “The Phantom”. This glovelet device creates an artificial sensation of touch through neurostimulation. Unlike existing bulky and tethered haptic devices, The Phantom is non-invasive, supports hand tracking, has a longer battery life than the average headset, and is compatible with any device, providing a truly immersive and dexterous experience.

name: aKin
description: Akin develops advanced AI systems at the intersection of neuroscience, chaos theory, and AI, focusing on symbiotic AI that adapts dynamically to users and environments. The company creates AI solutions for various sectors, including healthcare, government, and space exploration, aiming to foster a future where AI and humanity coexist harmoniously. Akin's AI applications range from personal assistants for daily living to sophisticated analytics tools for clinicians, emphasizing ethical development and public benefit.

name: Allevi
description: Through its versatile bioprinting platforms which can impact tissue engineering, organ-on-a-chip development, and pharmaceutical, Allevi empowers scientists to design and create complex tissue structures efficiently, advancing research in regenerative medicine and biomedical innovation.

name: ALL.SPACE
description: All.Space aims to bring high throughput satellite communications to scale through radical price and performance disruption. All.Space is leveraging its optical technology to develop all-electric, multi-beam, low power, multi-frequency smart terminals at a fraction of today’s cost and with a step-change in performance.

name: Arbol
description: Weather is one of the primary sources of risk on the planet directly affecting the livelihoods of over 2.5 billion people and 70% of all businesses. Parametric weather insurance is based on predetermined, verifiable, and objective metrics that customers choose at the beginning of their contract, such as yearly deviation in rainfall amounts or temperature. After deciding on a premium and selecting a payout amount, the end user relies on Arbol’s platform to handle the rest.

name: Armada
description: The landscape of internet connectivity is undergoing a significant shift with the emergence of satellite-based ISPs. Traditionally, remote and underserved areas have struggled with limited access to reliable internet due to the challenges of deploying and maintaining terrestrial infrastructure (like fiber optic cables). Armada aims to fill this gap by standing at the crossroads of space and terrestrial technology. By developing a full suite of AI-powered tools for edge computing, Armada is not only complementing Starlink's connectivity but also enhancing it with high-value industrial use cases in the most remote parts of the world. The company’s mission is to bridge the digital divide through a suite of dedicated industrial device solutions to unlock the power of real-time computing in any location across the globe.

name: Astrobotic
description: Astrobotic is pioneering lunar logistics and space robotics, offering end-to-end delivery services to the Moon for payloads and scientific instruments. The company provides a comprehensive solution encompassing spacecraft design, testing, launch, and lunar landing. Astrobotic's product lines include the Peregrine and Griffin lunar landers, which cater to a variety of mission needs, and the CubeRover, a modular planetary rover. With a focus on accessibility and innovation, Astrobotic aims to make lunar exploration more attainable and cost-effective for commercial, academic, and governmental entities.

name: Atlas Space Operations
description: The company's Freedom™ platform allows operators to access real-time satellite data with a single integration, offering scalable and efficient support for spacecraft, from single missions to entire constellations. With over 50 active antennas in 20+ countries, ATLAS serves commercial, civil, and defense clients, driving down costs and accelerating data delivery from space to Earth, facilitating mission success and operational agility.

name: Bliq
description: At the center of the mobility revolution occurring over the past decade is ride sharing, when introduced by early players such as Uber and Lyft, it transformed the way we commute and interact with the environment around us. However, the lack of operational efficiency is a key reason why most mobility companies are not profitable today. Bliq is the first workflow tool for independent platform workers and aims to address a fragmented ecosystem that creates high idle and reduced earnings.

name: BridgeComm
description: Their technology offers high-speed, secure, and scalable communications across space, air, land, and sea. With capabilities like point-to-multipoint free-space optical communications and post-quantum encryption, BridgeComm enables seamless data transmission for government, enterprise, and space-based applications. Their infrastructure is designed to overcome the limitations of traditional communication networks, providing enhanced bandwidth and security for mission-critical operations. BridgeComm's solutions are crucial for supporting the growing demands of the space economy and terrestrial telecom sectors.

name: Canada Rocket Company
description: Satellites underpin payments, power grids, transportation, weather forecasting, and secure communications, yet Canada has long depended on other nations to place and maintain those systems in orbit. Without domestic medium-lift capacity, the country cannot independently launch, place, or maintain its own complex spacecraft. Canada Rocket Company is building that capability at home: a sovereign, reusable launch system designed, built, and flown in Canada.

name: ClearRoad
description: ClearRoad is building infrastructure-lite congestion pricing solutions, a GPS app that could save cities millions and create new revenue streams for municipalities in the post COVID world. In addition to being a tool to manage traffic and respond to climate change, ClearRoad is also considering negative congestion pricing schemes for essential or marginalized workers, creating a new tool for cities to build equity with their poor/marginalized citizens. Empowering governments can help them respond to any crisis or changes to policies synchronously and tap into a myriad of solutions to traffic, funding, and mobility problems.

name: Cognitive3D
description: Cognitive3D has identified an opportunity to collect spatial intelligence, leveraging virtual, augmented, and mixed reality devices as a vehicle for data collection. The technology provides an innovative approach to consumer research, which enables brands to develop better product strategy, and understand consumer behaviors through a unique quantitatively measured platform. In this new domain, analytics insights are exponentially more important for immersive content than traditional mobile applications, as users are actively participating in the experience, vs. passively consuming content.

name: dataPlor
description: dataplor provides cutting-edge location intelligence by integrating advanced AI, machine learning, and human validation to deliver accurate, up-to-date global POI data. The platform enables businesses to enhance decision-making, streamline operations, and optimize resource allocation through detailed insights into consumer behaviors and market trends. dataplor's comprehensive data covers over 250 million locations across 200 countries, supporting industries like retail, fintech, logistics, and real estate in their strategic planning and competitive analysis efforts, ensuring reliable and actionable location intelligence for global market expansion​.

name: dClimate
description: dClimate aims to make climate data more accessible and reliable by directly connecting data publishers with data consumers under a modern architecture that is user-friendly and supports data immutability. The platform allows data providers and forecasting entities to monetize their work and establish domain variable standards that make consuming climate data simple enough for even the most casual user. dClimate is solving the inefficiencies of the existing climate data ecosystem and is becoming a source of truth for the businesses, farmers, multinational corporations, and governments who depend on this information to make important decisions.

name: echo3D
description: echo3D’s Content Management System (CMS), Content Delivery Network (CDN) and Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) are tailored for developers and content creators, providing them the convenience of streamlining their server setup, data pipeline creation, content management without having to develop any infrastructure from scratch.

name: Eclipse Space
description: Satellite communications underpin national security, connectivity, and economic resilience, yet the capability to build and operate a megaconstellation has sat with a handful of trillion-dollar companies. For most nations and enterprises, the choice has been to commit enormous capital or to depend on infrastructure that someone else owns and controls. Eclipse Space changes that: full constellation infrastructure built to each customer's requirements and operated under their control, produced through a fabless model that can stand up in-country production lines for sovereign customers.

name: Exia Labs
description: Initially used for military training and strategic planning, wargames have become indispensable tools for modern defense and intelligence operations. Leveraging applied AI and gaming principles, Exia Labs is developing next-gen wargames that dynamically adapts to changing world conditions with space as a critical domain, providing real-time insights and uncovering asymmetric conditions that power military strategists and enterprise leaders alike to gain significant operational advantages, with space as a critical domain.

name: Fortastra
description: Fortastra builds compact, autonomous spacecraft that protect high-value assets in orbit. It's vehicles can close on a satellite, inspect what happened, escort a threat, and respond when distance isn't enough. Open-architecture autonomy lets them sense, maneuver, and coordinate when human operators can't stay in the loop. Founded in 2025, the company has flown two demonstration missions, most recently on SpaceX's Transporter-18.

name: Gaia AI
description: Gaia AI is building the Bloomberg terminal for forestry. More specifically, their platform consists of two core product lines: high-quality carbon credits (generated from proprietary data collection methodologies) and forestry inventory management software. With an AI-based data platform that produces higher-fidelity datasets than competitors and a founding team withunique hardware/software expertise, Gaia AI plans to unlock the largest supply of natural-based carbon credits.

name: GHGSat
description: GHGSat provides global emissions monitoring services, currently for greenhouse gasses and ultimately for a range of air quality and other trace gasses from anthropogenic and natural sources. Monitoring services are delivered using a patented, proprietary multi-platform system for collecting emissions data, and unique algorithms ingesting both GHGSat and third-party data to generate valuable operational, environmental, health & safety, and regulatory insights.

name: Globeholder
description: Globeholder builds AI agents that work like a research lab. Specialized agents form hypotheses, test them against data and physical constraints, and cross-check each other's reasoning before reaching a conclusion. Every step is traceable, so teams can audit how an answer was reached, not just accept it. The company focuses on capital risk allocation and project design in the construction and energy verticals, where decisions carry physical and financial consequences and unverifiable outputs aren't good enough.

name: Gradial
description: The recent emergence of Large Language Models (LLM) has shown promising developments in building tools that can turn unstructured data into useful information that can be leveraged to automate many aspects of business operations. While public LLMs have shown promise in turning unstructured data into useful information, they are not secured or tailored to specific business contexts. Gradial aims to bridge this gap by providing a self-managed cloud infrastructure and security to automate LLM integration for enterprises, with industry-agnosticcapabilities that can be tailored to specific industries.

name: Guardian RF
description: Guardian RF is redefining satellite communications by delivering advanced RF signal intelligence solutions through mesh networks and multi-modal sensing technologies. Their platform integrates real-time connectivity with scalable RF analysis, empowering defense sectors with precision insights. Guardian RF’s roadmap includes developing proprietary satellites to enhance signal detection and intelligence capabilities, enabling seamless integration with ground networks for global, real-time RF surveillance and communication systems.

name: HawkEye 360
description: By fusing their data with other sources, HawkEye provides powerful analytical products for applications such as maritime domain awareness, spectrum mapping, and monitoring. HawkEye 360’s advanced tools help users across government, defense, and commercial sectors improve visibility of global activities and gain actionable insights into critical situations, from tracking illegal activities to enhancing national security​.

name: ICEYE
description: Earth observation provides global information for many industries such as oil & gas, maritime, logistics, and insurance. However, 75% of the time, traditional remote sensing systems are unable to provide imagery data due to clouds or lack of daylight. ICEYE has developed a synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging platform that solves this problem. Unlike traditional remote sensing companies, ICEYE is able to provide remote sensing imagery data at all times of the day and regardless of atmospheric conditions.

name: Impulse Space
description: Although access to space has increased due to declining launch costs, transferring between orbits remains a significant hurdle. Impulse Space aims to change this with their game-changing infrastructure to enable nimble and cost-effective access to any orbit. Their breakthrough comes in the form of orbital maneuvering vehicles designed specifically for rapid and reliable last-mile payload delivery. These vehicles possess the remarkable ability to deliver multiple payloads to unique orbits with just a single launch.

name: Kayhan Space
description: Space is becoming increasingly congested and contested, posing a threat to the safety, security and sustainability of space assets and operations. By developing new methods of calculating collision probability, better space weather modeling, optimizing spacecraft maneuvering, and fusing next-generation automation to every step of satellite operations and spaceflight safety, Kayhan’s platform effectively removes delays and errors from the critical path of response to high-risk events through the delivery of autonomous flight alerts, notifications, and decision plans directly to their customers and stakeholders.

Before Zephr, the accuracy and error for each GPS data point was unique to its location solution. A networked solution not only improves each phone’s individual location solution, but also makes the network of data collected more accurate. The measurements made by networked devices have a consistent absolute accuracy observed independently. Users share their GPS errors with Zephr and, in return, they receive an optimized location solution to their mobile device. This means that Zephr does not need to transmit users location data helping ensure privacy for their customers.

funding_notes: Verified domain kallmorris.com; Kall Morris Inc (KMI), Marquette, Michigan, founded 2019, works on space-debris removal and relocation (REACCH grappler, Laelaps spacecraft; REACCH flew to the ISS on SpaceX CRS-31 in Nov 2024). In Nov 2023 KMI announced $5M in combined funding. Payload breaks this down as about $4.25M in SpaceWERX/AFWERX STTR/SBIR Phase II awards plus $750,000 from a closed pre-seed and seed round. Michigan Rise Pre-Seed Fund III led the pre-seed (first invested in 2021), and MSU Research Foundation's Red Cedar Ventures is also a backer. SEC Form D filings show the private money was raised through non-priced instruments: about $258K of debt-type securities (Jul 2021) and SAFEs of $215K (Mar 2023), $180K (Jul 2023) and $140K (Dec 2024), roughly $793K in total. The 'seed' was SAFE-based with no public priced seed round, so status is pre-seed/angel-only. amount_raised uses the company-reported $750K. Grants listed are SBIR/STTR (non-dilutive), and KMI also cites a partnered NASA SBIR Phase II.
