description: BlueDot Photonics is accelerating the deployment of next-generation solar technology by developing simple, cost-effective solutions to improve solar panel performance and durability. BlueDot's unique quantum-cutting technology makes today's silicon solar panels better. Up to 16% more energy, helping lower the cost of solar power by 10%.

name: Blue Frontier
description: Blue Frontier's mission is to transform buildings into sustainable, comfortable and interactive spaces through the commercialization of a revolutionary air conditioning technology. Blue Frontier’s AC system combines dew-point-style sensible cooling with liquid desiccant dehumidification to reduce electricity use by up to 90% (non-fan). Our system is able to solve an array of today’s largest sustainability problems — from the Duck Curve to peak load management, from humidity control to integration of intermittent renewable resources.

name: Calicat
description: Calicat uses proprietary methods to discover and test low cost electrocatalysts, ten thousand times faster than any other method. We then apply those low-cost catalysts to a very low-cost, disruptive-design hydrogen electrolyzer. With our IP and the world's largest electrocatalyst activity database, Calicat is uniquely capable of solving a key challenge for the Hydrogen Economy: producing low-cost Green Hydrogen.

name: Cambium Carbon
description: Cambium is developing the supply chain operating system for the $750B green building and timber market. Their platform for "Carbon Smart Wood™" transforms the way materials are sourced, processed, and delivered, leveraging proprietary technology to optimize each step of the supply chain, from log recovery (or harvest) to end-product sale. This platform enables Cambium to simultaneously meet growing demand for alternative building materials and resolve key operational pain points in the wood industry.

name: Daanaa
description: Daanaa is the only chip-based technology that allows energy to be transferred freely, safely, and efficiently. Through rigorous research, cutting-edge engineering, and a passion for sustainability, we partner with ambitious manufacturers to overcome energy challenges previously constrained by the limitations of physical hardware.

name: Gaiascope
description: Gaiascope ('Gaia') is dedicated to maintaining planetary balance and combating climate change. The best way to drive investment in, and return from, clean power projects is to make those assets as profitable as possible. Gaia's focus is the electric grid of the future: building the 'brain' for, arguably, humanity's most complex invention to date. We provide our customers the capability to optimize returns of their renewable and energy storage assets with price forecasts and bidding strategies tailored to their needs.

name: Headroom
description: Headroom (formerly Archetype) is a new type of application-building platform that empowers business users to create and manage their own high-quality internal tools, by using process and policy as the source of truth, rather than code. The three founders previously worked together at Palantir, where they designed, built, and brought to market a comprehensive no-code platform that has helped enterprises around the world increase their operational efficiency by shipping internal software faster than ever before. Now, they are building Archetype to bring these superpowers to every small and medium business, because all companies should be software companies.

name: Heimdal
description: Heimdal's vision is to develop megaton-scale DAC systems before 2030 to meet the world's decarbonization needs. Their technology aims to provide a scalable solution for removing significant amounts of carbon dioxide directly from the atmosphere, contributing to efforts to mitigate climate change and achieve net-zero emissions targets. Heimdal’s facility in Hawaii has already captured nearly 40 tons of CO2 per year using renewable energy. They are now working on a commercial demonstration facility called Project Bantam in Oklahoma, which will have the capacity to capture over 5,000 tons of CO2 annually.

name: HEVO
description: HEVO was founded in 2011 by Jeremy McCool with a mission to eliminate global reliance on fossil fuels by accelerating the adoption of electric vehicles. The HEVO team spent nearly a decade on developing a cost competitive, third-party certified, manufacturable, and highly efficient wireless EV charging product suite. By enabling drivers to simple park and power up, HEVO paves the way for mass adoption of electric vehicles.

name: HST
description: HST is a pioneer in applying search technology to accelerate the path to a zero carbon world. Their suite of digital solutions engages companies of any size to purchase radically more clean energy and make the world cleaner. View® applies it to clean energy development and Cue® applies it to clean energy procurement. Together, both platforms from HST enable more Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with balanced risks for cost-competitive, wholesale clean energy.

name: Ion Storage Systems
description: ION's radically different battery concept enables safe, high energy density cells without the use of precious raw materials like graphite. Instead of graphite, ION uses a ceramic cell design that requires no anode material. Its cell extracts the lithium already present in cathode materials and uses its highly conductive ceramic to plate it as lithium metal into engineered voids.

name: Loamist
description: Loamist is the pioneering cleantech feedstock platform that connects suppliers of bio-waste streams with emerging cleantech startups focused on using these feedstocks to decarbonize industrial materials. As a catalyst in the cleantech sector, Loamist is committed to driving growth and making significant contributions to global decarbonization efforts.

name: Magrathea Metals
description: Magrathea Metals is a San Francisco-based company founded in 2022 that develops and manufactures magnesium metal from seawater using an innovative electrolytic process. They are focused on producing carbon-neutral magnesium, addressing a critical gap in global magnesium supply chains.

name: Nth Cycle
description: Nth Cycle’s technology transforms the outputs of metal scrap, electronics recycling, untapped mining resources, and waste from existing mines into high-purity critical minerals ready to be used in new production. Nth Cycle’s unique, modular electro-extraction technology supports refiners, miners and battery recyclers as an alternative or enhancement to older, emissions-intensive hydrometallurgical and pyrometallurgical processes.

name: NxLite
description: NxLite (formerly 3E Nano) is redefining what’s possible in high-performance glazing — unlocking unprecedented energy efficiency without compromising transparency or design. By dramatically reducing heat loss while maintaining crystal-clear visibility, NxLite tackles one of the building industry’s toughest challenges: cutting carbon emissions from windows at scale. It’s a breakthrough solution that makes net-zero buildings not just achievable, but economically compelling.

name: Pearl Street Technologies
description: Pearl Street Technologies' mission is to enable a more reliable, resilient, and sustainable power grid through advanced modeling, simulation, and optimization tools. By leveraging powerful circuit simulation methods developed to study billion-transistor electronic systems, SUGAR™ (Suite of Unified Grid Analyses with Renewables) offers industry-leading convergence robustness for power grid analysis.

name: Polycarbin
description: Polycarbin is a resource management platform that is transforming the single-use scientific supply chain of today into the sustainable, circular economy of tomorrow. With on-site sortation made simple with intuitive diversion bins, coupled with the visibility offered by proprietary waste analytics platform, Polycarbin offers an environmentally responsible and cost-saving medical waste management solution.

name: Pronoia
description: Pronoia is building the world's first physics-based battery to unlock large-scale energy storage. Pronoia is accelerating the transition to 100% renewable energy with novel energy storage technology that improves capacity by orders of magnitude.

name: Rain
description: Rain equips fire agencies to stop fires before they grow out of control, using automated aircraft stationed throughout high risk areas. Rain integrates with early detection sensors to dispatch nearby autonomous helicopters within seconds, so that fires can be contained within minutes.

name: Refiant
description: Refiant develops a new class of AI architecture that replaces brute-force scaling with a more efficient, nature-inspired approach, reducing energy consumption while increasing capability. As AI systems scale globally, Refiant enables resource-efficient, cost-effective, and sustainable compute

name: Reframe Systems
description: Reframe Systems is at the forefront of revolutionizing home construction with its advanced prefabrication techniques. Reframe is redefining home building by delivering high-quality, sustainable homes more efficiently than traditional methods. By combining advanced robotics, prefabrication techniques, and data-driven manufacturing, Reframe is shifting away from the inefficiencies of traditional construction toward a smarter, more agile approach.

name: Salient Energy
description: Salient Energy supports a rapid transition to clean energy by making safe, sustainable, and affordable zinc-ion batteries to power the clean energy revolution, providing a scalable alternative to lithium-ion.

name: Sepion Technologies
description: Sepion brings a differentiated approach to replacing graphite anodes with lithium metal by combining the latest in nanoscience, polymer chemistry, and cell engineering to safely unlock a 40% increase in electric vehicle range with a gigafactory-compatible solution.

name: Skyven Technologies
description: Skyven is a decarbonization partner helping large industrial facilities identify, fund and build attractive solutions to reuse thermal energy and reduce fuel spend. Skyven is a nationally recognized leader in commercial and industrial decarbonization of thermal energy, backed by distinguished institutions such as the National Science Foundation (NSF), California Energy Commission (CEC), and the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA).

name: Sylvatex
description: Sylvatex (SVX) is an advanced manufacturing technology company that collaborates with electric vehicle (EV) battery manufacturers. Their proprietary waterless process produces cathode active material (CAM) using fewer steps and less energy. We are addressing the core of the EV battery scaling challenges: cost, supply, and carbon footprint. The technology greatly reduces the time to produce CAM in reactors a fifth the size of traditional reactors. Thus manufacturers have improved capacity and return on capital.

name: TexPower
description: TexPower is a U.S.-based battery materials company that develops and manufactures advanced cathode materials for lithium-ion batteries used in electric vehicles and energy storage systems. Its core innovation focuses on cobalt-free chemistries — such as lithium iron phosphate (LFP) and nickel manganese aluminum (NMA)—that improve performance while reducing cost, supply chain risk, and environmental impact. By replacing scarce and expensive materials like cobalt with scalable alternatives, TexPower is helping strengthen domestic battery supply chains and accelerate the transition to cleaner, more affordable electrification.

name: Texture
description: Texture turns fragmented energy data into a single source of truth that enables live automation, standardized integrations, and cross-system action for energy use cases like grid response, energy management, and distributed resource coordination. As the grid becomes more distributed and dynamic, Texture turns complexity into coordinated action.

name: Thea Energy
description: Thea Energy is reimagining how fusion power gets built -- starting with a fundamental rethink of the magnet. Spun out of Princeton University and the Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory, the company is developing a stellarator, a type of fusion device that can run in a continuous, stable state without sudden plasma disruptions that have long plagued its better-known cousin, the tokamak. Traditional stellarators achieve that stability through magnets with elaborate, custom-sculpted three-dimensional shapes. This has historically made stellarators impractical to manufacture and maintain at scale. Thea's key insight is to flip that logic: instead of building complexity into the physical shape of the magnets, they use arrays of simple, flat (planar) coils and let software do the heavy lifting. The result is a fusion system that is not only more stable, but dramatically easier to build, service, and replicate -- a critical ingredient for deploying fusion energy at real-world scale.

name: Traxen
description: Traxen Inc. is a pioneering company at the forefront of innovative solutions in the transportation industry. Committed to revolutionizing the movement of goods, Traxen specializes in the development of cutting-edge technologies that optimize fleet management and enhance overall efficiency. Through a blend of advanced data analytics, artificialintelligence, and a deep understanding of logistics, Traxen strives to create intelligent solutions that not only improve operational performance but also contribute to a more sustainable and connected future in transportation.

name: Type One Energy
description: Type One Energy was born from a dinner conversation at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, where leading stellarator scientists decided to stop waiting for academia and build the next leap in fusion themselves. The founders didn't just study stellarators; they built five of them, including UW-Madison's HSX machine and Germany's Wendelstein 7-X, the world's largest. Their approach preserves the stellarator's defining feature (i.e., physically twisted, non-planar magnets that hold superheated plasma in a stable, continuous flow) but unlocks it with two modern breakthroughs: high-temperature superconducting (HTS) magnets that generate far stronger fields than conventional materials, and advances in supercomputing that enable plasma optimization at previously impossible precision. Together, these clear the barriers that kept stellarators confined to research labs for decades. The company is building Infinity One, an engineering verification platform at TVA's Bull Run Energy Complex in Tennessee, scheduled for 2029, followed by Infinity Two, a 400-megawatt commercial fusion power plant designed to put clean electricity on the grid.

name: Veckta
description: VECKTA is simplifying and accelerating the transition to a more profitable and sustainable energy future. VECKTA empowers businesses to competitively deploy onsite energy solutions across their operations. In one integrated Platform, business leaders have access to actionable insights and a vibrant marketplace of vetted providers to confidently plan, assess, deploy and monitor their energy transition strategy with maximum efficiency.

name: Wattch
description: Wattch's data analytics platform offers monitoring and intelligence services for distributed energy systems. The company's platform utilizes artificial intelligence and IoT to predict usage and provide predictive maintenance, and offers time monitoring, alerts, and remote diagnostics, enabling companies to determine the condition of in-service equipment in order to estimate maintenance downtime.

name: XGS Energy
description: XGS Energy is a geothermal energy company whose proprietary heat harvesting technology and closed-loop well architecture enable global deployment of terawatt-scale geothermal heat and power. XGS Energy’s system recirculates the same water over and over again through a closed-loop, hermetically-sealed system. By eliminating the need for large volumes of water, XGS Energy's solutions make geothermal production possible even in water-scarce regions.

name: ZERO
description: Zero is a home electrification marketplace that provides a convenient platform for homeowners to plan, purchase, and schedule home electrification projects. Zero provides homeowner-friendly electrification guidance & assistance through a virtual home assessment, a custom-tailored roadmap, and scoped & priced electrification projects without a single home visit.

name: 6K
description: 6K is accelerating the industrial transformation of advanced material production with sustainable manufacturing through its UniMelt®system, the world’s first industrial microwave plasma platform. 6K’s mission is to deliver high-performance advanced materials that are radically greener than legacy production technologies. Currently tackling materials for energy storage and additive manufacturing, the UniMelt platform offers multifaceted sustainability benefits and answers critical environmental challenges such as CO2, hazardous waste, greenhouse gases, energy consumption and wastewater.

name: Atana Elements
description: The need for the minerals that underpin our transportation, technology, and manufacturing is growing at unprecedented speed. To keep up, we need intelligent and efficient ways to identify, secure, and develop new dissolved mineral resource deposits. Atana has developed a better, smarter way to find and develop high-value assets quickly and with great precision. By combining data science and technology with deep geological and subsurface expertise, we uncover valuable resources others overlook.

name: Caporus Technologies
description: Caporus’ patented capacitor technologies enable reliable capacitive energy storage and filtering at the higher voltages and temperatures required by the next generation of high density power conversion systems. Caporus dielectrics employ Nanoscale Lamellar Porosity (NLP) to meet the increasingly demanding requirements for power conversion systems that are key to supporting the electrification of transportation and integration of distributed energy resources on the grid. Caporus is expanding its operations beyond facilities at Argonne National Laboratory to add a pilot plant in the southwest suburbs of Chicago that will support scaling production of its dielectrics and capacitor products.

name: Conamix
description: Conamix is commercializing new low-cost high-energy materials for the global lithium ion battery market. The company’s materials are designed to drop-in to existing manufacturing infrastructure to both improve the energy density and lower the cost of lithium ion systems. Founded in 2014, the company is led by an experienced team of chemical and battery industry leaders and has intellectual property agreements with multiple leading global research institutions.

name: CorePower Magnetics
description: CorePower is driving magnetification by redefining the limits of magnetic solutions for EVs and the grid. The combination of advanced manufacturing processes and novel materials represents a long-awaited and significant advancement in efficiency and power density in power electronics and power conversion systems and has the potential to reduce the need for rare earth elements in electric motors.

name: Divigas
description: Divigas has invented a new polymeric membrane (Divi-H), which can purify hydrogen up to a level of 99.95% purity from any feedstock composition, with best in class recovery rate, and is robust even under the most adverse feed conditions. Divi-H can be used in a wide range of applications, from fuel gas recovery to loop optimization through H2/CO adjustment and carbon capture, and can operate in refineries, petrochemical plants, ammonia plants, methanol production, metallurgical production, power-to-gas systems, gasifiers and many other locations.

name: Echion Technologies
description: Echion Technologies (Cambridge, UK) supplies its world-leading Niobium-based anode material, XNO®, to cell manufacturers looking to build lithium-ion batteries with market-leading safety, cycle-life, and fast-charging capabilities. XNO® enables batteries to fast charge safely in less than 10 minutes, with high energy density and a cycle life of more than 10,000 cycles.XNO® materials are based on proprietary mixed Niobium oxide compositions and microparticle designs protected by 13 international patent families and are now being scaled-up to the multi-thousand tonne/year production scale. The differentiated technology helps cell manufacturers gain a technical and commercial advantage in high-value, fast-growing markets where end-users require the safety, low total cost of ownership, and unique performance mix offered by XNO®.This includes industrial and commercial e-mobility markets: rail, marine, AGVs, mining trucks and other off-highway vehicles, opportunity-charging e-buses and other high-utilisation EV fleets. XNO® also provides a unique value proposition for the micro-battery market and specific applications for the ESS, motorsports, and medical markets. ‍

name: Energy Vault
description: Energy Vault creates renewable energy storage solutions designed to advance the global transition to a carbon free, resilient power grid and transform the world’s approach to utility scale energy storage. At Energy Vault, we work to combat climate change by enabling clean and reliable electricity through innovation in renewable energy storage. Utilizing a unique approach to the circular economy that integrates energy waste for beneficial reuse at unprecedented economics, Energy Vault innovates to accelerate the shift to a fully renewable world.

name: FluoRok
description: FluoRok (Oxford, UK) is reinventing fluorochemicals manufacturing and the way the world accesses fluorinated products such as Li-ion battery electrolyte salts and additives. FluoRok’s proprietary process bypasses for the first time the energy intensive intermediary hydrofluoric acid (HF), one of the most hazardous and difficult-to-handle chemicals on the planet. FluoRok’s solutions are safer, more sustainable, lower cost, and introduce for the first time the circular economy in fluorochemical manufacturing. Spun-out of the University of Oxford, UK in 2022, the team has decades of combined experience in fluorine chemistry and business development and is currently working towards their first pilot plant.

name: Iontra
description: Iontra Inc, a Denver-based battery performance and safety technology company, has been in stealth mode for nearly a decade and is partnered with various OEMs to commercialize its breakthrough charging technology that will replace incumbent CC/CV charging and drastically reduce the development time of new batteries and battery-powered products. Iontra has found a fundamental way to materially reduce degradation in lithium batteries when charging or discharging, opening the door to more than two-fold improvements in charging speed and cycle life, improved capacity utilization, and safe cold-temperature charging.

name: Khemia Metals
description: Khemia Metals is enabling more sustainable batteries by replacing critical metals with earth-abundant alloys. Khemia leverages high-throughput alloy discovery to develop alloys that are mechanically robust, electrically conductive, and electrochemically stable in battery electrolytes. Khemia is commercializinga next-generation alloy current collector to replace copper foil allowing for lighter, cheaper, and greener batteries.

name: Liminal
description: Liminal is accelerating the transition to electric mobility by transforming battery manufacturing with better data and analytics. Their battery manufacturing intelligence solutions leverage ultrasound and machine learning technology to improve battery cost, quality, and reliability.

name: Monolith
description: EXITED INVESTMENT: Monolith has developed a platform solution that leverages AI and machine learning to solve intractable physics and engineering problems in the testing and validation space. The company has identified battery and EV testing as its beachhead market where extended test cycles in the West put companies at a distinct disadvantage compared to their Chinese counterparts. Monolith is already helping a number of tier 1 automotive companies to optimise their battery testing, enabling them to bring products to market faster. After expanding in this beachhead market, Monolith will apply its platform to the testing and validation space in other industry verticals, such as semiconductors.

name: Monomyth Materials (M2)
description: Monomyth Materials (M2) is a Chicago-based advanced materials company controlled by Monomyth Group, a diversified holding company founded by Chip Dunn in 2017. Its subsidiaries include M2Graphite, which is developing America’s first commercial-scale battery-grade synthetic graphite capacity, and M2Innovations, which advances next-generation materials such as silicon anode technologies and SiOx production through its NanoGraf asset acquisition. Together, M2 is the only integrated active anode material producer in the Western Hemisphere, building a compliant dual-use supply chain and U.S. battery lab network.

name: Nanoscale Components
description: Nanoscale Components has developed a novel, cost-effective process to pre-lithiate lithium-ion battery electrodes. This process enables cell manufacturers to use high-specific capacity materials such as silicon to make cells with higher energy density and improve the cycle life of those materials.

name: Natron Energy
description: Natron Energy’s mission is to transform industrial and grid energy storage markets by providing customers with lower cost, longer lasting, more efficient, safer batteries. Natron’s battery products are based on a unique Prussian blue chemistry and can integrate into a wide variety of energy storage applications ranging from critical backup power systems to EV fast charging and behind-the-meter applications. Natron’s batteries are UL1973 recognized and have passed rigorous UL9540A fire testing, offer higher power density, faster recharge and significantly longer cycle life than other energy storage technologies. Natron builds its batteries using commodity materials on existing cell manufacturing lines. Natron is backed by leading venture capital investors including ABB Technology Ventures, Chevron, Khosla Ventures, Nano Dimension, Prelude Ventures and Volta Energy Technologies.

name: Niron Magnetics
description: Niron Magnetics is developing the world’s first advanced manufacturing process for the mass production of permanent magnets powered by its breakthrough material formulation. Niron’s proprietary Iron nitride magnets possess inherently higher magnetization and can be produced at a lower cost compared to today’s rare-earth magnets and will enable a revolution in the design of new electric motors and generators.

name: One Next Energy
description: Our Next Energy Inc. (ONE) is a Michigan-based developer of innovative energy storage solutions with a vision to rapidly expand the world’s access to sustainable power. Founded in 2020 by Mujeeb Ijaz, a battery systems engineer with more than 30 years of experience, ONE and its team of experienced battery engineers are focused on safer battery chemistries that use the most sustainable raw materials while creating a reliable, low cost and conflict-free supply chain.

name: OneD Battery
description: OneD’s SINANODE™ technology platform fuses nano-silicon into commercial graphites – increasing the performance of EV batteries while lowering costs. Silicon nanowires provide 3,250 mA/g of reversible capacity and avoid the expansion and breakage issues of other solutions such as silicon oxide. The result is faster charging, longer range, and affordable EVs.With over 240 patents, OneD Battery Sciences has joint development agreements with many industry partners including GM, which is also an investor.

name: Percepto
description: Percepto’s holistic solution enables fully automated inspections and continuous monitoring of critical infrastructure around the globe. This is all facilitated by a visionary team based in the US and Israel, focused on pushing the boundaries of industrial automation.

name: Pyka
description: Pyka is America’s leading manufacturer of dual-use, heavy-lift autonomous aircraft. Its autonomous electric crop protection aircraft are in daily commercial use by some of the world’s largest agricultural producers, lowering spray costs for growers by increasing efficiency and reducing chemical use. Pyka is extending its commercially proven autonomy stack to hybrid-electric aircraft, advancing a new paradigm for dual-use logistics and defense capabilities. The platform delivers long-range, heavy-lift performance with the flexibility to support multiple missions in environments with limited infrastructure. Pyka’s vertically integrated manufacturing enables scalable, cost-effective production across its products.

name: Quadric, Inc.
description: Quadric, Inc. is a semiconductor IP licensing company that delivers the blueprints for efficient, flexible AI processors to a wide range of customers designing chips for varied applications. Their licensees are both semiconductor companies who sell to broad user bases as well as systems companies designing chips for their own internal use. They focus on solutions for AI inference in devices and on the edge – the deployment of AI models in real world situations.

name: Resonant Link
description: Resonant Link delivers 5x faster and highly-efficient wireless power for applications big to small, from massive industrial trucks to medical devices smaller than a fingernail. Resonant Link is anchored by offices in South Burlington, VT, Zurich, CH, and Boston, MA, and has amassed double-digit customers in healthcare, electric vehicles, and consumer electronics. With backing from top investors and government agencies, Resonant Link is poised to continue its exponential growth and lead the movement to electrify work, logistics, transportation, and patient care to help people, businesses, and the planet thrive.

name: Solid Power
description: Solid Power is an industry-leading developer of all solid-state rechargeable batteries for electric vehicles and mobile power markets. Founded in 2012 as a spin-out from the University of Colorado Boulder, Solid Power replaces the flammable liquid electrolyte in a conventional lithium-ion battery with a proprietary sulfide solid electrolyte. As a result, Solid Power’s all solid-state batteries are safer and more stable across a broad temperature range, can provide a 50-100% increase in energy density compared to the best available rechargeable batteries, enable cheaper, more energy-dense battery pack designs and are compatible with traditional lithium-ion manufacturing processes. Solid Power has extensive partnerships with both BMW and Ford to jointly develop all solid-state batteries using the company’s Louisville-based megawatt-hour-scale (MWh) production line. In addition to Volta, Solid Power is backed by prominent investors including Samsung, Hyundai, Ford, and Solvay.

name: Summit Nanotech
description: Summit Nanotech Corporation is a cleantech organization transforming how the world accesses lithium for the global energy transition. Through their proprietary and sustainable direct lithium extraction (DLE) technology, Summit Nanotech is protecting natural resources and optimizing operations for lithium producers in South America.

name: Addis Energy
description: Addis harnesses natural geologic processes to produce ammonia at lower cost and with lower emissions. Its approach accelerates subterranean reactions to enable modular, scalable, and decentralized chemical manufacturing.

name: Adiabatic Materials
description: Adiabatic Materials produces pharmaceuticals and industrial chemicals using electricity instead of fossil-based heat. Its platform runs reactions selectively at room temperature, yielding the target product at high purity with far less waste and few byproducts — and bringing supply chains for essential medicines and fine chemicals back onshore.

name: Aepnus
description: Aepnus is developing an electrochemical platform to produce lithium salts and other industrial chemicals cost-competitively through electrified processes. The technology replaces fossil-driven production with modular, scalable routes designed for batteries and heavy industry.

name: Allie AI
description: Allie integrates data across machines, sensors, and factory systems to make operations observable and controllable. Its AI-powered analytics and agents detect anomalies, automate workflows, and optimize throughput, efficiency, and cost.

name: Alta
description: Alta uses engineered proteins to extract rare earth elements and other critical minerals from e-waste, tailings, and ores. Its biologically mediated separation systems operate under mild conditions and can refine materials below the cost of conventional processes, reshaping where and how critical minerals are sourced.

name: Andes
description: Andes helps farmers improve their farms’ efficiency and improve soil quality. By engineering microbes that fix carbon in soils, Andes lowers input costs and emissions while turning cropland into a durable carbon sink.

Care specialists are available to answer questions and assist clients through each step of planning and service. name: ANAPHITE
description: Anaphite offers an industry-leading solution to the challenges of dry coating cathodes with its chemical compositing process to make dry coating precursor powders. The patented technology has the potential to make EV battery manufacturing 30% less carbon intensive and 40% cheaper, and the UK-based company is already working with global car and battery cell manufacturers. Anaphite has patented chemistry-based battery electrode production technology that reduces the cost of EV batteries by 5-10% - independent of the battery chemistry. The company has already proven the technology’s capability in lithium-ion battery production, and it will also be applicable to a wide range of new battery technologies, including sodium-ion and solid state. The team’s exceptionally pragmatic and future-focused mindset is another key asset. Alex and Sam brought in Joe Stevenson as CEO in 2022 when they were looking to scale and reach customers. Joe is an experienced commercial lead at the helm of the company, and has helped Anaphite progress to the next level. This type of foresight is absolutely essential when creating new technology companies, where’s the next gap and how to fill it, and puts them in the best position to scale quickly. The scale of Anaphite’s ambition and potential is also clearly reflected in the consortium of the Series A. We’re experienced investors based all around the world, from our round co-leads Maniv in the US/Israel, to EEI in Japan, and Nesta in the UK. We all believe this company has what it takes to win across geographies. This company is setting new standards for battery production and can help us reach a decarbonised future faster and more efficiently. We're looking forward to helping Anaphite’s technology go global and reduce the costs of the entire battery industry to the benefit of all. name: Barocal
description: Barocal is replacing harmful refrigerants with high-efficiency solid-state cooling technology for the $500B global HVAC market. Cambridge-based Barocal is commercialising solid-state cooling using barocaloric materials, a breakthrough resulting from 15 years of research at the University of Cambridge. Instead of cycling high-GWP refrigerant gases like conventional systems, Barocal’s technology applies pressure to proprietary solid-state barocaloric materials to transfer heat. This eliminates refrigerant leakage and the emissions associated with it. Why we invested in Barocal The climate case : Cooling emits over 4 Gt CO₂e annually, accounting for more than 7% of global greenhouse gas emissions, which makes it one of the largest decarbonisation blind spots. These emissions come from HFC refrigerant leakage, which often have global warming potentials more than 1,000 times higher than CO₂, as well as from the energy intensity of cooling itself. Cooling demand is projected to triple by 2050 , further increasing these emissions. Barocal directly addresses both leakage and energy consumption by eliminating refrigerant gases entirely and delivering significantly higher efficiency than existing solutions. The business case : The global HVAC market is worth approximately $450 billion and is expected to grow to $577 billion by 2033. Barocal is initially focused on commercial chillers and data centre cooling, targeting some of the fastest-growing and most profitable segments. The company is working in collaboration with large OEMs to bring the technology to market. In addition to the emissions benefits, higher efficiency reduces energy costs and results in a lower total cost of ownership for customers. The team : Prof. Xavier Moya, Co-Founder and CEO, is a Professor of Materials Physics at the University of Cambridge and a globally recognised pioneer in caloric materials and barocalorics. He has authored more than 150 scientific publications with over 15,000 citations. He founded Barocal to commercialise his breakthrough research, funded by the Royal Society and the European Research Council. Dr. Giles Rodway, Co-Founder and CTO, brings decades of industrial R&D experience from the automotive sector and previously founded Spinetic, combining deep engineering expertise with proven entrepreneurial credibility. Website: https://barocal.com/ Founded 2019 Management Prof. Xavier Moya Dr. Giles Rodway Location Cambridge, UK Segment Industry World Fund Investment Stage

name: Enerkii
description: enerkii is slashing industrial energy bills while decarbonising one of Europe’s hardest-to-abate sectors. The Munich-based company provides a full-service, emissions-free energy system for industrial and commercial players across Europe. By combining software intelligence with on-site renewable infrastructure, enerkii enables companies to cut their energy bills by up to 50%, with zero upfront investment. Through its unique “Energy-as-a-Service” model, enerkii is eliminating the complexity, risk, and cost of industrial decarbonisation. Why we invested in enerkii The climate case: Energy production accounts for ~75% of global CO₂ emissions, and industrial energy use remains one of the slowest sectors to decarbonise. Over 80% of industrial sites in Germany still rely on fossil fuels despite increasing renewable availability. enerkii directly addresses this by enabling affordable, zero-emission on-site energy generation. With 87 MW of contracted capacity already secured, enerkii is on track to reduce industrial emissions at scale - just as Germany and the EU accelerate towards 2030 renewable energy targets. The business case: enerkii unlocks an enormous untapped market: the decarbonisation of Europe’s commercial and industrial sectors. While competitors focus on point solutions, enerkii offers a fully integrated system, including solar, battery storage, charging infrastructure, and (soon) heat pumps. These assets are backed by a proprietary Operating System (OS) that configures optimal setups in minutes. Their business model is elegant and compelling: no investment, no complexity, just savings. enerkii already has 18 contracts with major German industrial players, and is well-positioned for Europe-wide expansion. The team: Co-founder and CEO David Balensiefen is a serial entrepreneur who previously co-founded gridX, which he successfully exited to E.ON. He is joined by gridX veterans Henry Thierhoff and Hendrik Abel, forming a team with deep technical knowledge, proven operational execution, and a bold vision for building Europe’s next major decentralised energy provider. name: FARMLESS
description: FARMLESS CREATES CARBON NEGATIVE, FUNCTIONAL PROTEINS THAT CUT OUT THE NEED FOR AGRICULTURAL LAND. The Farmless process combines the ancient craft of fermentation – which has been used for millennia to brew beer and bake bread – with a modern feedstock, the scientific term for a starter liquid. Why we invested: The climate case: Whereas most fermentation companies rely on sugar, Farmless uses a feedstock made from CO2, water, nitrogen and renewable energy – bypassing the need for agricultural land. The business case: the demand for meat and dairy is set to soar with a growing population, and we need dramatically more efficient, scalable ways of protein production - fast. Farmless’ technology will help scale alternative proteins which meet long-term, buoyant consumer demand. The team: the Farmless team, led by Adnan Oner, combines physicists, food experts, communications leaders and data analysts who will drive the start-up forward in the coming years. name: Hyperscale Power
description: HYPERSCALE POWER IS BUILDING THE NEXT GENERATION OF ELECTRIC POWER INFRASTRUCTURE. The Zurich-based deeptech company is developing compact solid-state transformers (SSTs) designed for the power demands of AI data centres, EV charging, and large-scale renewable energy systems. Hyperscale Power’s proprietary design is roughly 10× smaller than conventional transformers and uses around 90% less material, dramatically reducing deployment timelines from years to weeks. By leveraging high-frequency operation and advanced power electronics, the system achieves energy-conversion efficiencies of up to 98.5% – significantly higher than today’s solutions. With a clear efficiency, cost, and emissions advantage, Hyperscale Power is positioned to unlock faster electrification and power delivery for the infrastructure underpinning the next industrial era. Why we invested in Hyperscale Power The climate case: Electricity systems lose around 6–8% of generated power globally through transmission and conversion inefficiencies. At the same time, the rapid growth of AI compute, EV charging networks, and renewable power generation is dramatically increasing electricity demand. Hyperscale Power’s solid-state transformers offer up to 98.5% energy-conversion efficiency and enable more flexible, modular grid architectures that can integrate renewables more effectively. Even a 2% improvement in efficiency at hyperscale data-centre and grid level translates into millions of tonnes of avoided CO₂ emissions. The company’s compact design also reduces material usage by roughly 90%, lowering embodied emissions and supporting a more resource-efficient power infrastructure. The business case: Hyperscale Power is entering a rapidly expanding multi-billion-euro market driven by hyperscalers, electrification, and global investment in energy infrastructure. Transformer supply chains are currently strained, with lead times stretching to 18–24 months as demand for high-power systems accelerates. Hyperscale Power’s SST technology dramatically shortens deployment timelines while delivering higher efficiency and power density. This creates a compelling value proposition for data centres, EV charging networks, and renewable-energy operators that need faster, more efficient power conversion to meet growing electricity demands. The team: Hyperscale Power was founded in 2025 by Daniel Rothmund and Sami Pettersson, who each bring more than a decade of experience in solid-state transformers and medium-voltage high-power converters. Their deep technical expertise in power electronics and transformer architecture underpins the company’s proprietary design. Based in Zurich, the team benefits from close ties to Europe’s leading engineering ecosystem around ETH Zürich, positioning the company to attract top technical talent and rapidly bring its technology to market. Website: Hyperscale Power Founded 2025 Management Daniel Rothmund, CEO Sami Pettersson, CTO Location Zürich, Switzerland Segment Energy World Fund Investment Stage

name: LITHOSQUARE
description: Lithosquare is accelerating critical minerals discovery with AI-driven geological intelligence that addresses the global supply bottleneck. The Paris-based company helps mining companies identify, rank and advance high-potential copper, lithium and rare earth deposits, faster, with higher confidence and at a fraction of the traditional cost. What sets Lithosquare apart is its geology-first approach. Where most AI-exploration tools look for statistical patterns in historical data, Lithosquare reasons from the science of how deposits form. Its platform is built around a proprietary metallogeny ontology covering around 20 deposit types, developed and maintained by PhD metallogenists working alongside AI engineers. This allows the system to generate credible targets in greenfield areas where no historical training data exists, a capability that pattern matching approaches cannot replicate. Why we invested in Lithosquare The climate case: Only around 1 in 1,000 mineral exploration projects ever becomes a mine, yet global demand for copper, lithium and rare earths is accelerating as electrification and AI infrastructure intensify. Average mine development lead times have stretched to nearly 18 years, creating a critical gap between exploration decisions today and production needed in the 2030s and 2040s. Lithosquare directly addresses this bottleneck by accelerating high-confidence discovery in jurisdictions that can meet Western supply-chain resilience requirements. By bringing new reserves to market faster and from jurisdictions with stronger environmental standards, Lithosquare unblocks the materials supply that global electrification depends on. The business case: Global mineral exploration budgets have historically ranged between $12-15bn annually, with a portion allocated to target generation, data analytics and technical advisory. Lithosquare's asset-light, partnership-driven model captures exploration service revenues while retaining long-term economic upside through Net Smelter Return royalties on successful discoveries. The global royalty and streaming sector has a combined enterprise value of over $140bn. Early partnerships validate strong demand for AI-accelerated exploration workflows and demonstrate traction across both large-cap operators and mid-tier explorers. The team: Co-Founder and CEO Aymeric Preveral-Etcheverry previously scaled Fieldbox, an industrial AI company. COO Simon Leclair brings 15+ years of mining expertise, including early-career mine development work at Eramet and 8 years as a partner at BCG specialising in Metals and Mining strategy. Both are Mines Paris graduates, combining deep geological credibility with proven operational execution and AI expertise. Website: https://www.lithosquare.com/ Founded 2024 Management Aymeric Preveral-Etcheverry, Co-Founder & CEO Simon Leclair, Founding COO Location Paris, France Segment Industry / Critical Materials World Fund Investment Stage

Why we invested: The climate case : DAC is essential for achieving our global net-zero targets. According to the IPCC , up to 10 gigatonnes of CO2 must be removed from the atmosphere annually by 2050. DAC will enable the reversal of the temporary overshoot from historical emissions and emissions from hard-to-abate industries. The business case : Mission Zero's electrochemical DAC system is primed to overcome the current bottlenecks of affordability and scalability through significant energy savings, increased process efficiency, and a modular scale-up approach. The company is expected to achieve market-leading CO2 prices at a capacity of 1,000 tonnes of CO2 per year, facilitating a commercially feasible scale-up roadmap. name: NITRICITY
description: Nitricity is electrifying organic fertilizer production with a world-first, plant-based alternative that’s transforming agriculture. The US-based company has developed Ash Tea , a liquid organic nitrogen fertilizer made from recycled almond shells, air, water, and renewable energy. Fully vegan, pathogen-free, and cost-competitive, Ash Tea is already sold out for years to come, with farmers lining up to secure supply. With its first commercial-scale facility breaking ground in Delhi, California, Nitricity is scaling globally to meet surging demand from organic growers in the US and Europe. Why we invested in Nitricity The climate case: Conventional fertilizers made through the Haber-Bosch process are responsible for ~2% of global GHG emissions, while also degrading soils, polluting waterways, and driving biodiversity loss. Worse, up to 70% of nitrogen applied is lost to the environment 1 . Nitricity’s organic, circular alternative cuts emissions by more than 90% and restores soil health, while replacing animal-based fertilizers with a cleaner, safer option. By producing nitrogen fertilizer from agricultural waste and renewable energy, Nitricity directly addresses one of agriculture’s most urgent decarbonisation challenges. The business case: Nitricity is addressing the $150B global fertilizer market, starting with a beachhead in organic nitrogen fertilizer for high-value crops, a segment worth over $11B on its own 2 . Farmers are eager for better, affordable solutions, and Nitricity delivers. Its product flows seamlessly through irrigation systems, avoids clogging, and enables more efficient nitrogen use, cutting input costs. With over $150m already in its sales pipeline and binding offtake agreements stretching through 2028, Nitricity is scaling from proven demand, not speculative adoption. The company’s Series B raise, closed in the third quarter of 2025, will accelerate US expansion, advance R&D, and build the European customer pipeline and partnerships in preparation for international growth. The team: Founded in 2018 by Stanford graduates Dr. Nicolas Pinkowski (CEO), Dr. Joshua McEnaney (President & CTO), and Dr. Jay Schwalbe (CSO), Nitricity began with a solar-powered experiment on a lemon tree. Today, the founders lead a 38-person team with deep scientific expertise, a clear commercial track record, and a bold vision for circular, plant-based fertilizer production. Their entrepreneurial grit, coupled with strategic backing from leading climate and agri-tech investors, positions Nitricity as a future global leader in sustainable fertilizer. Website: Nitricity 1 Yara , Our World in Data 2 McKinsey Founded 2018 Management Dr. Nicolas Pinkowski, Co-Founder & CEO Dr. Joshua McEnaney, Co-Founder, President & CTO Dr. Jay Schwalbe, Co-Founder & CSO Location Fremont, California, USA Segment Food, Agriculture & Land Use (FALU) World Fund Investment Stage

name: NZN
description: Net Zero Nitrogen (NZN) is pioneering a new generation of sustainable agriculture with its breakthrough biofertilizer solution. The UK-based agtech company is developing a novel bioinoculant using naturally occurring endophytic bacteria that colonize crops to reduce the need for synthetic nitrogen fertilizers (SNFs). Unlike most alternatives, NZN’s solution is non-GM, requires no new machinery, and is easy to apply. It offers farmers a “green discount”: lower costs with higher yields and reduced emissions. NZN has already shown strong traction in ASEAN, where it is preparing to scale with the support of major climate-focused investors. Why we invested in NZN The climate case: Synthetic nitrogen fertilizers are responsible for ~2% of global GHG emissions (1.13 Gt CO₂e) and are a leading source of nitrous oxide, a greenhouse gas nearly 300 times more potent than CO₂. The production and overuse of SNFs also damages soil microbiomes, pollutes waterways, and drives biodiversity loss. NZN’s bioinoculant technology delivers up to 88% fewer emissions during production and mitigates downstream pollution. This makes it a powerful lever for climate mitigation in agriculture, a sector often overlooked in decarbonisation. The business case: NZN is entering a $200B global fertilizer market with a solution that’s both more sustainable and more cost-effective. The product requires no regulatory exemptions, no GM approval, and no farmer behavior change. It’s already generating significant traction in ASEAN markets through multiple proof-of-concept trials and interest from major agri-input distributors. With minimal transmission loss and no nitrous oxide leakage, NZN offers not just a green premium, but a green discount. The team: CEO Justin Hughes brings entrepreneurial vision and leadership experience as a former Red Arrows pilot, while CSO Dr. Gary Devine leads scientific development with deep biological expertise. Together with co-founder Alan Burbidge, the NZN team combines scientific rigour and strategic execution, positioning the company to transform one of agriculture’s most polluting inputs. Website: NZN Founded 2022 Management Justin Hughes, CEO Gary Devine, CSO Alan Burbidge, Hd Corp Affairs Location Nottingham, United Kingdom Segment Food, Agriculture & Land Use (FALU) World Fund Investment Stage

name: PLANET A FOODS
description: Planet A Foods is a food-tech company that developed a technology platform to create a socially-just and environmentally-friendly food industry. They develop sustainable, future-oriented products free from any highly-limited resources such as cocoa or palm oil. All items are created from solely natural ingredients - with the first use case being cacao butter & cacao powder. Why we invested: The climate case : Chocolate production comes at a high cost for the planet. The rising demand for cocoa is a major driver for the deforestation in tropical forests, which are some of the most important carbon sinks on our planet. Climate change itself - and the broader biodiversity crisis - is also threatening the viability of producing cocoa. The business case : the great barrier for any food-tech business is the taste test. Planet A Foods’ Nocoa product offers a nearly identical taste and texture to conventionally produced chocolate - because of its fermentation approach - the best on the market we have tried. The team : CEO Maximilian has previously founded 27Pilots, a boutique consultancy helping startups secure venture funding. Prior he also worked in the automobile industry for half a decade. CTO Sara was a researcher at the Technical University of Munich, analysing the molecular structure of coffee, before working as Principal Scientist at Atomo Coffee, and as Head of Flavour at the Zurich University of Applied Sciences. name: Quantum Diamonds
description: QuantumDiamonds accelerates semiconductor development, improves production yields, and is poised to become the only startup to win manufacturing funding under the European Chips Act. Quantum Diamonds Sensor Technology (QDST) is redefining chip testing with world-first quantum sensing tools that detect hidden defects in complex semiconductors. The Munich-based company enables manufacturers to identify faults in 3D chip architectures before energy- and water-intensive processing steps, reducing waste and emissions. QDST’s platform provides non-destructive, nanometer-scale current imaging, pushing the boundaries of semiconductor metrology. Already working with global chip leaders, QDST is scaling manufacturing with support from the European Chips Act to meet soaring demand for high-yield, high-performance chips. The climate case: The semiconductor industry’s energy use has surged by 125% in recent years, with yield losses causing unnecessary energy, water, and material consumption. QDST’s breakthrough testing tools catch defects early, improving yields and cutting emissions by over 5% through yield optimisation. Additional emissions savings are expected from battery-yield optimisation, as well as from the indirect effects of accelerated EV adoption and enhanced computing efficiency. At scale, these combined effects will drive significant CO2 reductions across critical industries, directly supporting global decarbonisation efforts. The business case: As chips become denser and more complex, today’s tools fall short. QDST is entering a €20B market with a unique solution that solves a growing industry bottleneck. Its quantum sensing system enables accurate, fast, and non-destructive testing of advanced chips, critical for AI, HPC, and EV technologies. Already used by leading global chipmakers, QDST is now scaling production and deployments to become the new testing standard in semiconductor fabs worldwide. The team: Co-founders Kevin Berghoff, Dr. Fleming Bruckmaier, and Prof. Dr. Dominik Bucher lead a world-class team of physicists, engineers, and software developers from TUM, ETH Zurich, LMU, and Harvard. With backing from semiconductor veterans with decades of experience at ASML, Intel, TSMC, and Applied Materials, QDST combines deep technical excellence with strategic industry insight. name: SPACE FORGE

Space Forge’s in-space manufactured semiconductors can reduce energy usage by 75% - by harnessing unique space conditions of microgravity, vacuum and low temperatures. In-orbit manufacturing can bring about an 88% increase in computational efficiency, as well as a 50% reduction in costs compared to production on Earth. name: VAERIDION
description: Munich-based aircraft manufacturer VÆRIDION is developing a zero-emission electric Microliner that is on track to deliver affordable regional flights in Europe by 2030 . VÆRIDION is the first e-aviation company to have secured a milestone Pre-Application Contract (PAC) with the EASA – a highly significant achievement that confirms VÆRIDION’s Microliner meets certification standards for commercial passenger aircraft, and puts the company ahead of competitors. Their patented prototype Microliner will start as a nine-seater aircraft. The Microliner has a nominal range of 400 km plus IFR reserves, has already passed initial functional and validation tests, and has prototype flights set to take off in 2027. The company has plans in place to scale the technology to long-term offer pan-European flights. The Microliner is a fixed-wing aircraft with advanced battery-wing integration and multi-engine single propeller configuration, all designed for maximum safety and efficiency. It emits less noise than conventional aircraft, making it well-suited to smaller airfields and easy to roll out in underserved areas. Delivered at scale, it would help drive economic growth and accessibility. Europe is currently nowhere near reaching its sustainable aviation goals, and the Microliner presents a long-term solution. VÆRIDION has already signed its first customers in Denmark (Copenhagen AirTaxi and Copenhagen Helicopter), Benelux (ASL Group) and Germany (Aero-Dienst). The Microliner will initially serve business passengers before expanding into consumer travel. The company already wields a world-class team made up of 38 aerospace, software and automotive experts, and partnerships with institutions including TU Munich and Bauhaus Luftfahrt e.V. In 2024, VÆRIDION also opened a state-of-the-art battery development facility at the Bosch Collaboration Campus and launched a Dutch subsidiary, which will allow VÆRIDION to leverage the innovation ecosystem surrounding TU Delft and accelerate the journey to commercialisation. VÆRIDION is also exploring applications for the aircraft in air ambulance services in collaboration with Aero-Dienst, which operates a fleet on behalf of ADAC.
